Lifeguards face frustrating distractions involving lost gear, wayward children, ball games, and somersaults. A mother searches for her 6-year-old son last seen in the surf. The arrival of blue bottles overwhelms the lifeguard tower, and a small boy must alert them to a drowning girl.

Jack and Azza race to the aid of a young surfer on the shoreline who insists he hasn't been in the water even though he's dripping wet. Maxi, normally one of the nice guys, has to lay down the law when he rescues two patients who don't cooperate.

A Swedish tourist comes off second best while showing off his backflipping skills. After a girl is rushed to the tower suffering an anaphylactic shock, Jackson must administer the EpiPen. Lifeguards reap the rewards after Chase and Max land two huge fish onto their jetskis.

New trainee Jethro earns praise from senior lifeguards for rescuing a man more than double his size, but his fortunes reverse when he accidentally locks himself in the lifeguard tower and struggles to find a way out. Later he is faced with a woman found barely alive at the bottom of the cliffs.

62-year-old lifeguard Harry faces the risk of losing his job as he competes against younger colleagues in a fitness test, thieves face a violent citizens arrest and lifeguards are startled by the frantic search of a mother calling for her daughter, Jennifer.

The Rooster NRL team go surfing with lifeguards, but run over Yatesy on a rescue board, breaking his ribs and puncturing his lung. Quinn attends to a teenage girl with a broken nose and shattered vanity. A rescue proves difficult when Luke learns his female patient is deaf.

Tommy showcases the art of rescue in the funniest moment of the season. An unmanned boat drifts off Bondi. Troy rescues a young girl in front of the tower with her dad unaware of the dilemma. Glick takes Kerrbox, who is afraid of heights, up in a helicopter.

Lifeguards lay down the law after a woman reports being spat on at Bondi Beach. New lifeguard Will attends a medical emergency involving an unconscious teenager. In the midst of a howling gale, a woman brings a fleet of giant inflatables to Bondi. Local larrikin Harries helps tame the wild toys.

Lifeguards must rescue a surfer being smashed against cliffs in huge seas. The jetski can't get close enough, and a rescue board would be deadly. Bacon and Whippet must go in using only flippers and a rescue tube. On the beach a group of drunk Irishmen dance in tutus and frolic in the nude.

A suspected body is seen floating in the water, prompting the launch of the jet ski. Ryan encounters trouble as he bogs the buggy. Jethro dislocates his shoulder on the jet ski and is taken to the hospital. Ryan redeems himself by rescuing a young man bouncing off the bottom of the ocean.
Trainee Lachie completes his first big solo save after pulling a struggling swimmer from a rip  the team farewell one of their most dedicated and most loved lifeguards.

Lifeguards respond to a woman with a suspected heart attack on Campbell Parade. Jethro treats a female backpacker experiencing anaphylaxis with an EpiPen. Jesse and Jethro compete: surfer vs. bodyboarder. A severe dislocated shoulder necessitates the use of two green whistles.

Chappo and H-man cautiously prepare a 19 year old German tourist for hospital after he's broken his back. Trainees Taco and Jesse have a difficult day in class struggling with the books, but get a chance to make the grade against the rest of the team in the annual lifeguard challenge.

Two brothers survive a lightning strike using resuscitation techniques learned from Bondi Rescue. Veteran lifeguard Whippet rescues two men simultaneously. Singlets treats a boy for a potential spinal injury, recalling his own son's similar injury two years prior. Gavin bogs the buggy at pack-up.

On the first sunny day of December, one man falls off the jetski rescue mat unnoticed. A dance party with 3000 backpackers behind the lifeguard tower results in numerous drug and alcohol-related issues. As the crowd swells to 40,010, head lifeguard Hoppo must decide whether to clear the water.

He declares his love, and, although Helen insists that her career will always come first, the two get married. Soon, Peter is consumed by jealous suspicions of his wife's male patients and embarrasses Helen several times. Fearful of driving her away, Peter launches into character-changing behavior to prove his love.

Christopher Pride (Jerry Lewis) has been offered an important commission in Paris but can't convince his girlfriend, Dr. Elizabeth Acord (Janet Leigh), to take some time off from her psychiatric practice. Elizabeth is worried about three of her female patients, all of whom are extremely hostile toward men and very needy. Christopher, anxious to leave for France, decides to impersonate the ideal man for each of Elizabeth's patients, in hopes of lessening their dependency on her.

It turns out that Dick's real estate office is just a front for a betting operation. When Ellen unknowingly takes a large bet from Dick's old flame, Peggy (Janis Carter), Peggy demands that Dick must either pay up or run off with her. It's up to the dizzy Miss Grant to find a way to extract Dick from this mess.

Dong Joo now asks why Dr. Kim pushed back his father's operation many years ago. Dr. Kim is left dazed and uncertain while they stand before the rest of the staff. The nosy journalist now starts interviewing more people outside the hospital to dig deeper for his juicy case on Doldam. With emotions about his past lingering around the hospital, Dong Joo continues on the cardiac operation that hits very close to his heart.

Dr. Kim and the rest of the staff make their way to the capital. Tonight, they put down their scalpels and medical gowns. They put on their best suits and bring in the physical evidence to dethrone the corrupt and unethical President Do. Yoon Wan tries to negotiate himself out of it, but Dr. Kim is not buying any of it. The press and cameras are on them when the injury of a lifetime takes place.

Dong-joo receives a letter from the United States but tries to hide its contents from Seo-jung. Seo-jung becomes concerned about Dong-joo, who seems troubled after reading the letter. Meanwhile, Kim Sabu's first love pays a visit to Doldam Hospital...

As Doldam Hospital suffers from a lack of doctors, Kim Sa Bu visits the main hospital to ask to send young doctors to him and runs into CS fellow Cha Eun Jae and GS fellow Seo Woo Jin. Seo Woo Jin is ostracized by other doctors because he had done whistleblowing on other doctors' corruption and malpractice. On the other hand, Cha Eun Jae always takes a tranquilizer before operations due to her operation fright.

Dr. Kim gets disappointed at Woo Jin and tells him to go back. But Woo Jin asks Dr. Kim for one more chance, and Dr. Kim gives Woo Jin a week of grace period to prove himself. Meanwhile, an important figure comes into the emergency room of Doldam Hospital. Do Yoon Wan, the chairman of the Geosan University Foundation, figures out the news and begins to work out his scheme.

Dr. Kim chooses the extreme method to save Minister Ryu. After Dr. Kim manages to bring Minister Ryu back to life, Min Kook starts doubting Dr. Kim's real intention and skills. After Min Kook announces the Minister's condition to the press, Dr. Kim just doesn't seem to care. Eun Jae asks Woo Jin to attend the second surgery, but he refuses.

Ujae continues to be cruel to Seoyeong and that has opened up an opportunity for Seoyeong to get closer with Yeonhui. Seoyeong withdraws her resignation and plans to tell Ujae the truth. But Ujae doesn't turn up and just tortures himself at Seungu's party. Meanwhile Sangu and Migyeong make peace whilst Seongjae and his mother reach an agreement with Gibeom. In the end, Ujae talks to Samjae and is convinced to give Seoyeong another chance and sends her to her brother's wedding unaware.

Ujae continues to discover more secrets about Seoyeong that seems to drive him to the end. Meanwhile, Jiseon shares how she met Seongjae and why she's so attached to him. Meanwhile Hojeong and Sangu return from their honeymoon and get ready to start their new lives as Migyeong gets drunk and tells Seonu something she shouldn't hear.

The truth behind Seongjae is revealed and to help quieten this turmoil, Ujae and Seoyeong put their troubles on hold. Meanwhile Hojeong is happy playing newlyweds and Minseok is enjoying his free life. In the end Jiseon confronts Executive Yun about Seongjae.
Major developments in Seongjae's true identity and the relationship between Seoyeong and Ujae. Hojeong continues to adjust to married life whilst Seongjae gets ready to confess his love for Eunsu.

Seongjae runs away from home because he can't handle the shock and Seoyeong and Ujae team up to get him back. They've put their troubles on hold for now which shows some hope that things might work out. Jiseon files for divorce whilst Minseok makes a successful debut. In the end, Seonu gets one step closer to ruining Seoyeong's life.

Having discovered Seoyeong's secret, Seonu works out a way to get her revenge. Seongjae is still on the streets and Seoyeong tries to cheer up Jiseon whilst Hojeong is living happily as the new bride.

When Nokyoung encounters Yeonwoo and Bogyeong together, she senses an ominous presence. Queen Dowager Yoon orders that the physiognomy of the young maidens be examined in preparation for selecting a future queen. Meanwhile, Princess Minhwa takes Yeonwoo and Bogyeong into her care as court maidens and, upon discovering that Yeonwoo is Yeom's younger sister, begins to openly favor her.

The Yoon Daehyeong faction schemes to place Bogyeong as the future queen of Gyotaejeon. Ahead of the royal selection of the Crown Princess, Hwon secretly expresses his wish for Yeonwoo to submit her maiden registration. Meanwhile, Princess Minhwa's feelings for Yeom deepen, and she stubbornly demands that the king grant her permission to marry him.

Yeonwoo remains at the royal villa, Eunwol Pavilion, devoting herself to rigorous court etiquette training. Unable to withstand the Queen Dowager Yoon's threats, Nokyoung casts a forbidden spell on Yeonwoo. Cast out of the palace and sent back to her family, Yeonwoo's illness steadily worsens. In secret, Nokyoung approaches Yeonwoo's father with a dangerous proposal.

Trapped in terror inside a coffin, Yeonwoo is ultimately rescued by Nokyoung and returned to the world—only to awaken with all her memories erased. Taking Yeonwoo's place, Bogyeong ascends as Crown Princess. As Crown Prince Hwon comes of age, the kingdom's political situation grows ever more precarious under the schemes of powerful in-law families.

Nokyoung repeatedly warns Yeonwoo to be wary of strangers. Defying Seol's pleas, Yeonwoo ventures into the streets, drawn by her desire to glimpse the king's royal procession. Catching sight of Hwon from afar, Yeonwoo is thrown into deep confusion.

To use Nokyoung's spirit daughter Wol as a human talisman, she is abducted. As Wol attempts to escape, she receives help from Yangmyung—yet fails to recognize him. Dragged into the palace, Wol is forced to enter Hwon's bedchamber as a shaman meant to absorb misfortune.

Sonic and the Freedom Fighters journey to Robotnik's lab in hopes of deciphering his roboti-sizer system. While underground, Sonic spots his now roboti-sized Uncle Chuck aboard a Badlands bound mine-train and devises a plan for his rescue.

While on a mission to the big city to replace Nicole's malfunctioning microchip, Sonic and Sally encounter the Guardian, a mysterious cloaked figure who guards a dormant wizard named Lazar and his computer of evil spells.
Sonic is hired into an obvious trap when a frustrated Robotnik decides to appeal to the Hedgehog's ego and announces a "race to determine the fastest on Mobius".

Sonic conquers Robotnik's latest evil - a vehicle designated to locate and destroy living tissue matter - during a solo mission to the Badlands. Upon Sonic's return, the Freedom Fighters honor him with a victory party.

When Robotnik launches a spy-orb that will uncover the Freedom Fighter's Knothole location, Sonic and Robot launch themselves up to the orbiting spy-sphere aboard a home-made rocket powered by Robotnik's discarded booster engine.
Robotnik announces that he will marry Queen Aleena in a plot to become the king of Mobius.
A captain of the Queen's guard is captured before he can reach the secret rendezvous where he was to meet Queen Aleena.
A homecoming is interrupted for Sonic, Sonia and Manic when Sleet and Dingo arrive to collect back taxes after returning to their birthplace.
Sonia discovers that the watch she received from her friend is actually a monitoring device for the Robotnik Intelligence Agency.
Sleet and Dingo plan to collect the taxes owed to Robotnik from the Duke of Velcronia but keep it for themselves.
The sinister Robotnik blackmails Cyrus, an old friend of Sonic's, by holding his father hostage.
On a trip to Port Mobius, Sonic, Manic and Sonia are told that ships are sinking due to the Mobian sea-beast.

programmes.d: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvořák. Mozart's Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician. The three-movement symphony features two vibrant outer movements with fanfares and rousing themes, while the quieter second movement is scored for strings

The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. But as the day of the ball dawns, Blueberry awakens with a bad cold. She doesn't know how to tell Huck that she can't go to the ball. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

programmes.st: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programmes.d: Berry Bitty City is abuzz as Berrykin Bloom introduces the biggest, juiciest, strangest fruit anyone has ever seen! It's the size of a house, shaped like a strawberry, colored like a watermelon and has a spiky pineapple top. "I call it the sparklestrawwaterpineberry!" says Berrykin Bloom. Princess Berrykin declares it the greatest achievement in Berryculture she's ever witnessed.
Lemon and Raspberry hire twins Sweet & Sour to help out in Strawberry's café, so Strawberry will have time to appear in an internet fashion contest.

Strawberry's world-traveling cousin Apple Dumplin' stops at Berry Bitty City. What starts as a brief visit becomes a series of comical misadventures that ends with Apple finding a new home with Strawberry and her friends.

Lemon and Raspberry's fashion podcast is saved by Apple, then almost sabotaged by Sweet and Sour when Lemon's "mood hair" runs amok, acting like the bickering twins, and the twins' comical argument is accidentally broadcast on the "berrynet."

When Sour wishes she could have a birthday all her very own, her twin sister Sweet grants her wish by forgoing celebrating her birthday. But what begins as a day that Sour has always dreamed of quickly becomes a disappointment when she misses her twin. With Strawberry's help, Sour gives her birthday back to Sweet with a special surprise.
When a comedy of errors causes Orange, Plum and Cherry to arrive late to their campout, they start off their annual tradition of telling tall-tales around the campfire.

At the girls' campout, Sour launches into a whopper of a yarn about the adventures she and Sweet had in the "Berry Deep Dark Forest." She tries to get Sweet to participate in spinning the tale, but Sour's over-the-top performance leaves Sweet behind. Toward the end, Sour graciously changes the story to pull Sweet into it, giving Sweet the opportunity to toss in an ad lib that makes a nice topper to Sour's story.

Apple isn't paying attention when Strawberry describes their campout tradition of telling "Tall Tales." So Apple tells her thrilling adventure of a wild road rally she entered, only to surprise the girls by proving the story is actually true.

Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City. When Strawberry's stuffed-up nose makes her bake a bad-tasting cake, Apple, afraid the truth will hurt Strawberry's reputation, proclaims it's delicious. The fib snowballs when the Queen of Berryvania reads Apple's review and orders Strawberry's new cake for her ball.

Sour teasing Apple escalates into a "prank war" between the two of them. After the girls' feud disrupts the town, they are sentenced in a Berry Bitty City-style trial to camp alone together for a whole weekend. Miraculously, they emerge best buds, and their friends are relieved, until Sour's influence on Apple turns her into a mini-Sour, and they have to do a personality "makeover" on Apple.
Berrykin Bloom's braggart cousin, Berrykin Bertram, has won the hot sauce competition at the local county fair year after year.

When Apple feels left out of a Berryball game and an advanced ballet class, she invents some "groove booties" programmed to dance to any beat. She temporarily impresses her friends with her dance moves, but when the groove booties go out of control and threaten the town's Berryball game, she is forced to fess up.

Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.
When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a strangerthe crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniquesto trace a lethal encounter.
Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

The protagonists Bloom, Stella, Flora, Aisha, Tecna and Musa live their daily life on Magix world, among lessons, loves, quarrels and moments of strong friendship. At any moment, when needed, they can transform into super-heroines, ready to defeat evil and save who is in danger.

Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

Arnold lends Sid his room for one evening, but the arrangement backfires when Sid keeps on borrowing the room. / Helga and Patty (the big girl) face off.

All the kids are paired with adults with interesting jobs except Arnold, who is forced to spend time with the Jolly Olly Man. / Harold believes it's his life's calling to become a butcher, but he slowly drives Mr. Greene, the butcher, crazy.

Casa Paradiso/Gerald''s Tonsils: Grandpa becomes tired of dealing with the boarding house and decides to sell./Gerald has his tonsils removed before a big concert and must come to grips with the fact that his voice has changed.

programmes.d: Phoebe Takes the Fall/The Pig War: Phoebe agrees to take a dive so that Helga can win a competition./The boys engage in a recreation of a historical battle, only this time their prized pig is in danger of losing his life.
Best Man/Cool Party: The Coach wants to remarry Tish and asks Arnold to be his best man./ Rhonda has a party and only invites the cool kids.
Sid''s Revenge/Roller Coaster: After Arnold accidentally embarrasses Sid, Sid seeks revenge./ Eugene wants to ride with the gang, but they all think he''s a jinx and won''t go with him.

Grandpa's Birthday/Road Trip: Grandpa thinks he's going to die soon because no one in his family ever made it past his age. He prepares to die, and Arnold tries to convince him that life is still worth living.

Arnold and Lila/Grand Prix: Helga, lost in a love reverie, writes "Arnold loves Helga" on a wall, but changes the name to "Lila" when the kids approach.  Lila thinks that Arnold loves her until he explains the mistake.

Girl Trouble/School Dance: Arnold tells Grandpa he''s tired of dealing with Helga''s nonsense.  Grandpa tells Arnold a story about a girl he had to deal with when he was a kid who treated him the same way.  She turns out to be Grandma.

Helga's Show/Flood: Helga does a standup routine at a school function and proceeds to insult all of her friends.  They are offended, prompting her to change her act to a more friendly and gentle routine.  She performs the new act, but it's boring.

Beka and Tyr are taken over by the energy from a dimensional tunnel. Dylan, Trance, and Harper must save them before they destroy the ship.
Dylan is framed for murder and must clear his name, all while finding the pieces of a vase said to grant the owner the "blessings of the cosmos."
The crew rescues a group of refugees, only to discover they have been subject to government experiments and are extremely unstable.
Beka's Uncle Sid runs for office in the New Commonwealth, but an assassination attempt causes the crew to act as his security.
When the Andromeda is attacked by space pirates, they are rescued by a long-lost spaceship from Earth.
The crew discovers that a rogue planet, Marduk, has been creating weapons of mass destruction.
A hitman by the name of the Leper is targeting the leaders of the New Commonwealth.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Ultimate Warriors from Ancient Times
programmes.d: Joseph and Speedwagon travel to Rome to meet another Hamon wielder, Caesar Zeppeli, who takes them to the enigmatic Pillar Men. While Joseph and Caesar clash, they arrive to find a grim awakening.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: A Hero's Proof
programmes.d: Caesar confronts Wamuu and the other Pillar Men, but falters, clearing the way for Joseph. But anxiety replaces audacity as Joseph’s plan invites a presumable death sentence.
In mysterious Venice, Joseph and Caesar begin training under the equally enigmatic Lisa Lisa. Let the Hamon “hell” begin!
Under Lisa Lisa’s tutelage, Joseph and Caesar must endure their final test. But while Caesar hones his skills, Joseph is stunned by an ancient and unexpected foe.
Joseph returns to Lisa Lisa, unaware of the bizarre stowaway he has delivered. A possessed confidant then attacks, ultimately sending the crew to Switzerland, where another revelation awaits.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: A Race Toward the Brink
programmes.d: Stroheim is back from the brink, now as a cyborg designed to secure the great Red Stone. Kars, however, is not willing to concede and wages war, even as the stone hurtles toward an alpine cliff.
Lisa Lisa paints a picture of honor when she reveals Caesar’s tragic past to Joseph. Meanwhile, in the face of certain danger, Caesar enters into a solitary battle to avenge his father.

Inside a shadowy St. Moritz hotel, danger leaves Joseph and Lisa Lisa no time to mourn as they follow a bloody trail to Wamuu and Kars. Luckily, Lisa Lisa manages to strike a deal—but, of course, with one condition.
Joseph and Wamuu finally face off in an equestrian one-on-one. But will Joseph’s adroit attacks and weapon-grasping prowess be enough to keep Wamuu’s millennia-old pride in check?

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Warrior of Wind
programmes.d: When the battle between Wamuu and Joseph comes to a head, the surprising confessions aren’t far behind. Now the final hour has come for Lisa Lisa and Kars—a fighter very different from his fellow Pillar Men.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Ties that Bind JoJo
programmes.d: With Lisa Lisa’s life on the line, Joseph must deceive the deceiver. Joining Joseph, Stroheim and Speedwagon arrive at the battlefield, where a family tragedy threatens to doom the world to a hopeless future.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Birth of a Superbeing
programmes.d: Having seized the Red Stone and the mask, Kars has become the Ultimate Being. Now the seemingly invincible entity has his sights solely on Joseph who, fleeing, has one final trick up his sleeve.
Suiryu finds himself in the depths of despair. Despite all Saitama’s strength, there’s still something bugging the hero that he just can’t shake.
The Monster Association issues a challenge to the Hero Association, telling them they have only three days to rescue the hostage Waganma.
Garou is at last surrounded by multiple heroes and forced to fight, even though he’s covered in wounds and nearly at his limit.

programmes.st: The Wiping of the Disciple's Butt
programmes.d: Silverfang and Bomb catch up with Garou while the hero hunter is battling Genos, starting a whirlwind, climactic battle!

Seeing the state Yuki is in, Kaname takes her from Zero, who is left speechless when he realizes what he has done.
A new ethics teacher, Toga Yagari, arrives at Cross Academy.
Zero tried to sink his fangs into Yuki, but he was able to get hold of himself just before he succumbed to his urge.

With a second Kira now on the loose, L asks Light to join the task force and pose as the real Kira in order to catch the copycat.
Light goes to Aoyama to discover the identity of the second Kira before L becomes more suspicious.
Light and Misa show each other their Death Notes, and Light asks Misa to have her shinigami Rem get rid of L.
Evidence turns up that points to Misa Amane as the second Kira.

Ibara and the other passengers rejoice after their train has successfully escaped from the Zone.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 4
programmes.d: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss hope to capitalize on some risky buys. Paul believes a strange collection of medals will honor him with profits, but will a pricey three-figure gamble purchase pay off for Kate?

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 5
programmes.d: Kate Bliss and Paul Laidlaw's final trip sees them through Kent. At an incredible auction in Bury St. Edmunds, the Antiques Road Trip record profit is truly smashed, and when the gavel finally goes down one expert is left close to tears.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 1
programmes.d: Christina Trevanion and James Braxton are in the Scottish Borders with a '60s Jaguar. James resorts to a flashlight as he rummages in the dark for an occasional table while Christina hopes some silver-plated cutlery will serve up a profit.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 2
programmes.d: Christina Trevanion and James Braxton's are in the cold and snowy Trossachs. James investigates some ancient treasures in a Glasgow graveyard and farmer's wife Christina learns why it was the Scots who transformed arable farming.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 3
programmes.d: Christina Trevanion and James Braxton start in Levenshulme, Manchester. James has the unusual problem of having too much cash, while Christina struggles with her limited funds, deciding to gamble them on a worn toy train.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 4
programmes.d: The seaside town of Southport in Merseyside is Christina Trevanion and James Braxton's next stop. Christina dibs her way to a purchase with a Scouting connection and James spends a vast amount of his cash on two Cantonese jardinières.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 5
programmes.d: In Whitley Bay, Christina Trevanion and James Braxton set off on their finale. Christina buys a Chinese silver bowl and James has found six Japanese porcelain teacups. After their buying spree, they head to Ayr for a memorable auction.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 1
programmes.d: Phil Serrell is joined by new Road Tripper Arusha Irvine on a jaunt around Herefordshire's antique shops in a 1976 Triumph Stag. Phil's joined by Daphne, his dog, while Roo finds a 300-year-old example of Georgian glass.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 2
programmes.d: Road Trip regular, Phil Serrell, plays a safe bet with a mahogany breakfast table, while Arusha 'Roo' Irvine's all at sea, gambling on an antique pond yacht.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 3
programmes.d: Roo Irvine and Phil Serrell explore Yorkshire and Derbyshire. Along the way they dig up coal mining musical history, Phil attempts to buy a horse and Roo picks up another piece of her favorite glassware.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 4
programmes.d: Phil Serrell and Roo Irvine explore Oxfordshire. However, will the Stratford upon Avon auction supply comedy, tragedy or both? Plus, how the Chipping Norton Scouts re-invented British baseball and the Queen of 19th-century science.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 5
programmes.d: As Roo Irvine and Phil Serrell motor through the Cotswolds, Phil picks up a Victorian marmalade cutter, while Roo hopes a 16th-century bronze thimble will earn her a big profit. But who will be victorious at the final auction in Newent?

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon, Day 1
programmes.d: Antique hunters Catherine Southon and Paul Laidlaw kick off a new series in Northern Ireland. They start as friends but there's a bust up before their first auction of the week at Omagh, County Tyron.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon, Day 2
programmes.d: Catherine Southon and Paul Laidlaw soak up the stunning scenery of Northern Ireland. Will the luck of the Irish be with our antique experts as they try to uncover some hidden gems to take to auction in bonnie Scotland?

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon, Day 3
programmes.d: Auctioneers Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon are halfway through their trip. Deep in the Scottish Borders, Catherine uncovers a pair of vintage glove puppets. But will they give her a helping hand at the Edinburgh auction?

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon, Day 4
programmes.d: It's the penultimate leg for auctioneers Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon, as they start in Callander and shop across central Scotland before heading for auction in Kinbuck.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon, Day 5
programmes.d: Auctioneers Catherine Southon and Paul Laidlaw embark on the last leg of their road trip, shopping in Perthshire and Angus. It's two auctions each -- who will win the final decisive battle in Aberdeen?

George and Katherine both try and persuade Webster that he can do without his teddy bear, which is lost.

Tamera crosses the picket lines to work at a supermarket, but soon realizes that being a "scab" isn't all it's cracked up to be.
Ray learns a "noteworthy" lesson in honesty when he "fibs" and tells a tone-deaf Tamera that she plays the piano well, and she winds up humiliating herself at a piano recital.

A frustrated Moesha longs for a promotion from 'gopher' to writer at Vibe magazine but believes that her boss, Joe Scott, would rather she pay her dues with something other than her writing talent.

Eager to get on the fast track at Vibe Magazine, Moesha pretends to be a reporter to land a Maya Angelou interview.  But her ambition, coupled with Maya’s advice, leads Moesha down an entirely different path than she’d planned.
Unable to resist the temptations of college life, Moesha and Niecy become regulars on the party circuit, until their attendance at a late-night frat party takes its toll in more ways than one.
Moesha is flying high after she gets a job tutoring one of the basketball team’s star players until she finds out what kind of game he really wants to play.
Things get tense at the Mitchell house when Frank discovers Moesha has been taking birth control pills – and he’s the last to know.

When Mary and Lester go to the reading of his uncle's will, they are both surprised to learn they have distant cousins whom they've never met, and even more confused when they discover they are a different color.
When Lester's old high school sweetheart comes to the neighborhood in search of a new home, Mary fears that she'll try to move in on more than just her turf.
Suffering from a very cold winter spell, the residents of '227' invade Mary and Lester's apartment, which is one of two apartments with heat.
When Pearl finds out that Calvin is failing his history class, Mary, Rose and Lester each take turns as tutor-in-residence.
Stiff competition inspires Malcolm and Eddie to turn McGee's into a casino.
Malcolm and his sister vie for the attention of the same woman.

programmes.st: A Police Officer And A Gentleman
programmes.d: Eddie is jealous when Nicolette agrees to accompany her commander to a police department dance.
Following her divorce, Eddie's mom arrives for a visit that coincides with one from Malcolm's dad.
Malcolm and Eddie decide to settle an argument by trading jobs for a day.

Lamont is upset when Fred announces that he plans to marry a young woman he has just met. When the young lady arrives at the house, Lamont is shocked to be face-to-face with one of his old girlfriends.

programmes.st: Home Sweet Home For The Aged
programmes.d: Fred is caught up in a series of frustrating situations when he becomes a resident of a senior citizens' home. Fred is put in the home by Lamont, who plans to work his way around the world on a tramp steamer and doesn't want to leave his father alone.

Lamont outsmarts himself when he buys what he believes is a rare antique commode for only $20. Fred disapproves of the deal. Lamont insists that he can sell it for $400. Mr. Osborne, husband of the woman who sold the item, offers to buy it back for $200.

Nine-year-old Jason (Lincoln Kilpatrick Jr.) worms his way into the Sanford yard and eventually into Fred's heart. Touched by the runaway's loneliness, Fred gets an idea to help others like Jason -- but he's not prepared for the results.
Fred, Lamont and Rollo almost become stars in an X-rated movie until they are faced with the 'naked' truth and the wrath of Esther.

Times may change…but these guys don’t! Eddie Murphy and Nick Nolte are back on the streets in this smash sequel.

Michael agrees to let Claire go on her first date with Tony.

Dee Dee musters up the courage to finally introduce her new boyfriend, the older Morris, to her parents. Though Charles and Big Dee Dee publicly approve, privately they try to get Dee Dee to break it off.

programmes.st: The Big Home Is Where The Car Is Episode
programmes.d: When Mona discovers that her new boyfriend is living in his car, she sets out to prove that she's not so shallow that it makes a difference. Meanwhile, Phyllis puts her war with Big Dee Dee on hold to help her weather a health scare.

programmes.st: The Big All Bets Are Off Episode
programmes.d: Mona, Dee Dee, Phyllis and Big Dee Dee have trouble getting along when they all play poker together at Mona's apartment. When Dee Dee loses to Mona she has a hard time accepting that she may not be the best at something.

Mona gets upset when her boss, Kai, seems to take all the credit for the Delicious Records talent search. However Kai explains that she will have to take the fall if the promotion fails, so she has to take control.
When Vanessa dates a successful, handsome man (WILLIE GAULT), Mark has an unexpected reaction.

programmes.st: Breaking Up is Hard to Do
programmes.d: Mark and Vanessa date each other, but their relationship encounters trouble immediately.

Mark mistakenly thinks that Eric has proposed to Vanessa so he asks her to marry him. Mark revokes the proposal when he discovers his mistake, but proposes to her again seriously on a scoreboard at a NBA game. Tim Hardaway and Gary Payton guest star.
After convincing Vanessa to marry him, Mark must buy her an engagement ring.

Lucius considers adding private baths to the floor plan of homes.

16 complete strangers check into Big Brother's Hotel Mystere, where mysteries lurk around every corner and nothing is as it seems.

The Power of Veto is on the line, will it be used to save one of the nominees? Plus, it's a shocking first Veto meeting of the summer.

Power will shift again as the Head of Household is up for grabs, and which three houseguests will be nominated for eviction? Plus Mickey still has a mystery power up her sleeve, will she unleash it tonight?
Who will pull off the ultimate heist and score the Power of Veto, and will it lead to another jaw-dropping Veto meeting?
Adrian, Kelley and Will go to battle in the BB Blockbuster!  Who will win Safety?  And who will be the next Houseguest sent to see Julie?

Sam is compelled to reveal the true nature surrounding his lack of maturity.
Hattie's decision to write memoirs causes unrest amongst her family and friends.
Linda reaches a point where the only one that can come to the rescue is her mother.
Linda receives a surprising phone call.

Danny can't take anymore of Sam's annoying behavior.

Danny goes into a funk after Troy leaves him.

programmes.st: The Man and the Bragging Snafu Episode
programmes.d: When Nick's colleague at the station encourages him to send Lindsey and Kevin to a private school, Nick and Suzanne look into it, only to be misled about the process.
Suzanne becomes overly consumed with Kevin's science project. Elsewhere, Lindsey revs up for driving lessons, only to emerge as a suspect when her mother's car is scratched.
Lindsey's romantic attentions turn to a young celebrity DJ, who only neglects her in return. Elsewhere, Suzanne teaches Kevin the art of doing laundry. Michael Strahan and Lil JJ guest star.

programmes.st: The She Got Game Night Episode
programmes.d: When the Kingston-Persons decide to have a game night, all bets are off, as unlikely friends are drawn to one another when paired together for games.
Nick flops in his efforts to help Kevin with Valentine's Day at school.
Suzanne serves on a committee at Kevin's school, but complications arise when her fellow female members disrespect her---but adore Nick.

programmes.st: The Whose Card Is It Anyway Episode
programmes.d: When Nick misleads Suzanne about spending a gift card, the couple appear before a TV judge to sort out the truth.
Nick plans a belated surprise honeymoon for Suzanne, but keeping it a secret causes complications. Elsewhere, Lindsey helps Kevin with his homework.
As Lindsey films a reality show about her family, Kevin comes across a gun in Suzanne's handbag---leading to drama and potential danger. Ice Cube and Chubb Rock guest star.

programmes.st: The Take Your Kids to Work Day Episode
programmes.d: When Lindsey accompanies Suzanne to work and meets an old friend of her mother's, a misunderstanding causes Lindsey to believe she may have an older brother.
When Troy provokes a bully at school, Kevin starts hanging out with the bully as a way to avoid getting beat up, until he learns to stand up for himself and Troy, his real friend.
When Suzanne catches Nick spying a racy rap video featuring a pole dancer, she sets out to show him her own pole-dancing prowess.
Linda reaches a point where the only one that can come to the rescue is her mother.
Linda receives a surprising phone call.
A heated discussion with Danny's family brings Troy to her limit.
Danny can't take anymore of Sam's annoying behavior.
In the final season opener, Linda worries about Danny isolating himself in his apartment.
Danny goes into a funk after Troy leaves him.
Danny is angry with his family and friends because of how they have treated Troy.
Linda continues to exhibit her dislike for Troy as symptoms from her pregnancy worsen.
Danny's family tries to reach him during an emergency.
Linda is in labor at the diner.
A missed call leaves Danny and his family in a bad place.
Still upset with his friends, Danny takes the advice of his family.
Nick is enlisted to host a charity walkathon. Meanwhile, Marilyn's bracelet goes missing, and the children train for their participation in the charity walk.

programmes.st: The Vianna and the Long Haitian
programmes.d: Neek plans to surprise Charmaine in South Carolina with a marriage proposal and invites the crew along for the event. A few unexpected guests and a powerful history lesson force everyone to revisit the past and be grateful for the present.
The happiest day of Charmaine's life is overshadowed by a rumor that won't die. Ryan decides it's time for a change at 9MAG and Don is just the one to make it.
Charmaine bounces back with a shop of her own, with London's hottest black female tattoo artist by her side. Ryan's business excels as his personal life struggles. Don and Ashley get unexpected news.

Zach brokers a deal with Draya in exchange for a date, they flirt with the idea of starting a shop romance. Charmaine and Neek plan for their future together and share some news with their moms. Ryan opens up about some family issues in therapy.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew This is Not a Talk Show
programmes.d: The pressure is on for Ceaser when Dutchess' parents arrive for their engagement party. Quani and Puma make it clear that this war isn't over. Sky struggles with the emotions she feels over leaving Tent City. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew All You Did Was Mess Up My Hair
programmes.d: Sky is freed from Tent City andTed is waiting outside for her. When Kathie has DNA results in hand, O'Sh*t deals with his past. Puma creates a plan to protect his family but results in a full-out brawl on the streets of New York City. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Searching for a Friend
programmes.d: In the wake of the fashion show incident, the crew works on rebuilding and proving that they are stronger than ever before. When Sassy shows up, Ceaser makes it clear that anyone associated with Puma is not allowed on his turf. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Water Slides & Shade
programmes.d: When Donna speaks her mind one too many times for Ceaser's liking, he sends her packing. A customer appreciation (aka mixxxy) field trip to a water park ends in fireworks when Sky finds out that Ted has been messing around. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew This Ain't No Call Time
programmes.d: In the wake of Puma's devastating loss of Ink 124, Ceaser meets with Med, who gives him the offer of a lifetime. Now, Ceaser finds himself torn between his inevitable and dreaded move to North Carolina, and the chance to run Harlem. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Your Dream, My Nightmare
programmes.d: Ceaser finds himself looking for a house in North Carolina. Daddy Rick fires up the grill for some good old Southern hospitality, and for Ceaser, the pressure is on. Back in Harlem, Sky checks in with Puma and tells him to man up. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew We Want Pre-nup
programmes.d: After turning down a dream offer, Ceaser questions the person he is becoming. Sky talks to a friend and figures out a way to find closure with a heartbreaking piece of her past. Dutchess is shocked when Ceaser asks for a prenup. Presented by VH1.
In the wake of the prenup ask, Dutchess and Ceaser discuss ownership of Black Ink. Quani visits with Tamia and Puma realizes that the distant is hurting his family. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Let Us Pray
programmes.d: Donna is finally given her shot at tattooing but struggles with her emotions over devastating news. Shit's new fling, Blue, comes in with a little stick that holds big news and has O S**t thinking about his future. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Ain't No Party Like a Black Ink Party
programmes.d: The crew throws down for a mixxxy party, and when a shocking video is played, Kathie loses it. Puma reveals some big news to Quani and asks her to come home to New York. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Behind the Ink
programmes.d: In the first ever Black Ink Crew Reunion, host Big Tigger reunites the cast for an exclusive mixxy party to relive three seasons of drama and air each others' dirty laundry.

After leaving Black Ink closed for a month, Ceaser is back in Harlem. In North Carolina, Dutchess still has to pay for unexpected renovations before her tattoo shop can open. Kathie warns O'Sh*t about child support payments.

Ceaser's arrest sends shock waves through Black Ink. Puma is opening up a brand new tattoo shop to give Black Ink a run for its money. All hell breaks loose when Ted hires a new tattoo artist behind Ceaser's back.

When Erin's informant is murdered, she blames herself and works to help Danny discover who killed him.
When a young woman commits suicide, Danny and Jackie suspect it was forced.
Danny accompanies a dangerous ex-mobster who is helping him find bodies on cold cases in exchange for leniency for his son on grand theft auto.
Danny and Jackie investigate a murder scene at a diner, where a witness claims a uniformed officer fled the scene after shots were fired.
When a rich woman dies of a heart attack, her eccentric daughter claims that she received a message from God, who told her that her stepfather (Guest Star Timothy Busfield) actually murdered her.
On the way home with his family, Danny hits a man with his car who is fleeing from a gunman, and his family gets caught in the crossfire when Danny fires his weapon at the gunman.
When a man's family is robbed and beaten in front of him, and the assailant is shot and killed, the Reagans debate about how far they would go to protect their family.
When a Reagan family friend, an undercover detective, is killed, Linda and the boys worry about Danny, as his relentless search for the killer takes a toll on his emotional state.
When Frank's close friend, a high-profile reporter, is almost assaulted while in town investigating a story, Danny and Jackie attempt to track down her would-be attacker.
As Erin prosecutes a woman accused of killing her husband, the defendant's attorney is murdered and Danny is assigned to the investigation.
Danny is put in a difficult position when a gun linked to a robbery is brought in to the NYPD's gun buyback program.
Danny causes waves in the department when he investigates a closed case, the suicide of a firefighter, at the insistence of the man's 12-year-old son.
Danny and Jackie are assigned to protect a key witness in a Russian mob trial, but when an attempt is made on her life, they realize there is a leak on the task force.
Danny and Jackie investigate the suspicious death of a high-rolling investor who sustained injuries in a fight, yet his hands are unmarked by trauma.
Frank must race to stop a biological weapon attack on New York City while keeping it a secret from his family during their most sentimental holiday, Mother's Day.
A dangerous criminal from Danny's past comes back to seek revenge and kidnaps Jackie. Meanwhile, Jamie meets his new partner.

When an injured woman recants her claim of domestic violence, Danny and Jackie look into it further, only to find that the woman is involved in a secret relationship with a high-powered councilman who also happens to be a friend of Frank's.
While hunting for a wolf, Joe is attacked by the wolf.  Adam also hunting for the wolf, hears Joe struggling with the wolf comes to Joe's aid.
While working as a substitute teacher, Adam uncovers an ugly secret about the territory's past that others prefer remain hidden.
Hoss is seriously injured internally and Ben seeks help from the only doctor within 50 miles, who happens to be in prison for murder.
Ben becomes irritable and reckless when the completion of an important timber contract is hindered by an old rival.

The Cartwrights are visited by their second cousin, Muley Jones of Weedville, Missouri who sings with a window-shattering voice and stirs up trouble with Indian negotiations that Ben is trying to ensure.

Clay Stafford signs on to work for the Cartwrights and shortly afterwards shoots and kills a man who accuses him of cheating at poker.  The miners warn Clay to leave town, but it appears he killed in self-defense.
Joe is goaded into facing gunman Dan Taggert, unaware there is more to be prearranged than he realizes.
Joe teaches Johnny Chapman how to use a gun for defense.  What Joe doesn't see is the deadly consequences that it has in the long run when Johnny becomes a gunfighter.
Joe struggles to understand whether his friend was right in killing a dying man who pleaded to put out of his misery.

Determined to prove he can succeed at something without the help of his Pa, Hoss, and Adam, Joe sets out on his quest and wins a timber contract for Ponderosa timber, and later discovers that having a family to rely on can definitely be an asset.

Little Joe convinces Ben to hire Harry Starr, a half-Indian who is accused by other ranchers of being a chronic horse thief. Joe sets out to prove the others wrong, but is the youngest Cartwright's trust misplaced?
Not one, but three mail-order brides show up unexpectedly at the Ponderosa, all of them believing they are to marry Hoss.
When Joe and his friend Mitch go after a puma, Joe climbs a big peak and throws his gun up higher, intending to crawl up after it.
Ben regrets that he helped Tom Slayden start a freight hauling business when Slayden sets out to ruin all the competition, and Joe is shot in the process.
So the Cartwrights will not be killed, one of Ben's oldest friends must make sure Joe does not win a horse race.
Lafe Jessup doesn't really want to be married, and now he's about to be a father!  The horse wrangler finds a fight with Hoss at his reluctance to perform his duties.
Joe is bushwhacked in the desert and awakens to find himself in Martinville, a town that may or may not be populated by ghosts.  An eerie, surrealistic and well-produced episode.
Boruto makes a desperate decision to prevent Momoshiki from taking over his consciousness again.
Sasuke appears before Naruto to warn him of impending danger. An inconceivable foe lies in wait as Sasuke, the Five Kage and Boruto, charge into another dimension!

Boruto Uzumaki, the son of the village leader, saves a boy named Denki Kaminarimon, who's being picked on by bullies.
After being suspended for the uproar he caused at the entrance ceremony, Boruto makes his way to the academy for the first time.
After getting caught in a fight between Metal and Shikadai, Boruto notices that Metal's chakra is warped, just like Denki's.

programmes.st: A Ninjutsu Battle of the Sexes!
programmes.d: At the suggestion of Shino Aburame, their homeroom teacher, Boruto and his classmates split off into gendered teams to capture flags placed on the roof.
A mysterious student named Mitsuki has transferred into Boruto's class from Hidden Sound Village.
Boruto, Shikadai and Mitsuki notice their teacher is acting different than he usually does, and Shino suddenly attacks them!
Cho-Cho's scared because she thinks she's being watched by someone, so she decides to catch them in the act.
A Visual Jutsu places Boruto within a dream, and afterward, Boruto declares the dream has awakened his Byakugan, the Kekkei Genkai unique to his mother's Hyuga Clan.
Under his father and grandfather's guidance, Boruto spars with his aunt Hanabi. No matter how hard he tries, he can’t activate his Byakugan in any form.

programmes.st: The Ghost Incident: The Investigation Begins!
programmes.d: Boruto nicknames the mysterious shadow "The Ghost" and is excited when he and his friends Shikadai and Mitsuki decide to solve the recent "Ghost Incidents."
During a tour of workplaces for their school assignment, Sumire, Wasabi Izuno and Namida Suzumeno get wrapped up in the Ghost Incident and are hurt.
The Ghost incidents suddenly come to an end and Boruto and his classmates are puzzled, but Mitsuki seems to know something they don't.
Seventh Hokage Naruto and his top advisors are shocked to learn who the perpetrator is from the results of Sai's investigation. Just then, Nue, an enormous otherworldly beast, appears!

programmes.st: The Path That Boruto Can See
programmes.d: The late Danzo Shimura was the founder and leader of the Foundation, an elite branch of the ANBU Black Ops. The recent incidents have been masterminded by someone who had sworn to carry on Danzo's wishes.
The ghost incident that threatened the Hidden Leaf Village is over, and now Boruto is unable to awaken the mysterious power he used.
Exam day is fast approaching, and everyone at the Academy begins preparing for them. Repeating a grade is a possibility if you fail a test.
Sarada agrees to return a teddy bear to a young patient at the hospital, but she forgets it on the train and goes into a panic.

programmes.st: A Day in The Life of the Uzumaki Family
programmes.d: The Uzumaki household is thrown into chaos when Himawari, Boruto's younger sister, catches a cold.

Boruto pulls a prank and is pursued around the village by Naruto. Seeing this, Sarada can't help but be exasperated, but a part of her grows wistful as she thinks of her father, Sasuke, whom she hasn't seen since she was a baby.
Sarada, who has doubts about who her real mother is, joins Cho-Cho, who is about to set out on a journey to find her ¿real parents?
Sarada arrives at the tower where her father is, only to be hurt by Sasuke's surprising words and actions.
Sarada is in shock after Sakura is captured by Shin's jutsu. Even Naruto, with his exceptional tracking skills, is unable to locate her.
Determined to rescue Sakura, Sarada pursues Shin with Sasuke, Naruto, and Cho-Cho.
The Hidden Leaf Village is filled with excitement upon the arrival of the Kage for the Five Kage Summit.

After the Halliwell sisters witness the kidnapping of Piper’s (Holly Marie Combs) friend (guest star Maureen Muldoon) son (guest star Scott Tera), they discover it’s the work of the Grimlocks, demons who take the sight away from young boys.

programmes.st: She's A Man Baby, A Man!
programmes.d: When Phoebe starts to have visions and feelings of a seductress who kills only men, the Charmed Ones cast a spell to find out who the demon is. The only glitch is the spell turns Prue into a man.
