programmes.d: Chip and Jo give a Tudor-style home modern amenities and a main suite.
Chip and Joanna share favorite transformations, outtakes and bonus clips.
Chip and Jo transform a house into a modern masterpiece for a young family.
Chip and Jo tackle one of their biggest transformations in Crawford, Texas.
Chip and Jo tackle a farmhouse for a family moving back to Waco, TX.
A couple searches for a sizable fixer-upper for their young family.

programmes.st: Touchdown for a Family in Need
programmes.d: Chip, Jo and Tim Tebow create a wheelchair accessible home for a family.
Chip and Jo return to their roots and buy a fixer upper to flip themselves.

A stellar cast, including Michael Caine, Laurence Olivier and Christopher Plummer highlights this epic telling of the greatest air battle in history, when the outnumbered Royal Air Force defeated the German Luftwaffe, saving England from invasion.

Winner of ten Academy Awards including Best Picture, this electrifying musical sets the ageless tragedy of 'Romeo and Juliet' in the slums of 1950s New York and stars Natalie Wood, Richard Beymer, Russ Tamblyn, Rita Moreno, and George Chakiris.
The legendary Jackie Robinson stars as himself in this inspiring biopic that traces his remarkable ascent from poverty to becoming the first black American to play major league baseball.
The story of the life and career of famed baseball player Lou Gehrig.

In their final screen performances, Clark Gable and Marilyn Monroe are at their luminous best as an aging cowboy and a disillusioned divorcee, each trying to adapt to new ways of life in John Huston's piercing classic. Montgomery Clift also stars.

With his family away for their annual summer holiday, New Yorker Richard Sherman (Tom Ewell) decides he has the opportunity to live a bachelor's life. The beautiful but ditzy blonde (Marilyn Monroe) from the apartment above him catches his eye.

This hysterical comedy from director Billy Wilder finds Tony Curtis and Jack Lemmon masquerading as women in order to elude irate Chicago mobsters while befriending a beautiful singer (Marilyn Monroe).

Intense, enthralling, and unforgettable, Sunset Boulevard stars Gloria Swanson as Norma Desmond, a faded silent-movie star, and William Holden as Joe Gillis, a down-on-his-luck screenwriter whom she enlists to help her make her triumphant return.
Maude is thunderstruck when the Ethiopian foster child she's supported for 20 years comes to America and turns out to be quite different from what she expected.
When Maude and Vivian go back to college for their thirty-year reunion, Vivian wants to go back in time and do it all over again -- this time without her husband Arthur.
When Carol's beguiling ex-husband suddenly turns on the charm and captivates the Findlay household, Maude and Carol are astounded to discover his motives.
Arthur is determined to teach his visiting grandson the important things in life, but it's the guilty grandpa who learns the most valuable lesson of all.

When Victoria Butterfield's self-righteous father comes to take her away from the 'permissive' Findlay household, Maude confronts him with his less-than-honorable secret. Roscoe Lee Browne returns in the guest star role of Mr. Butterfield.
Bobby and Tony’s friendship is on the line when they become embroiled in a hilarious love triangle and attempt to outdo each other in vying for the affection of a beautiful young lady.

programmes.st: The Lighter Side Of Angela Matusa
programmes.d: The overweight blind date Alex once had returned to the scene a svelte shell of her former self, and eager for the romance she yearns for with Alex

The riotous race of the century pits Alex against Louie in a winner-take-all bet to see who can bring in the most receipts. Lecherous Louie uses every dirty trick in the book to make sure he wins his prize—an evening with Elaine.

Elaine suddenly starts getting mysterious love letters. When she becomes intrigued by the poetic propositions, a couple of cabbies quickly claim responsibility, leaving Elaine with the hilarious task of discovering who is the amorous writer.
Felix is forced to depend on Oscar's help in the finals of the Golden Apron cooking contest.

programmes.st: Bunny Is Missing Down by the Lake
programmes.d: Felix and Oscar spend a rainy weekend in the country looking for a lost girl
Felix tries to make up with his divorced wife with a sentimental reminder of happier days.
Oscar develops a strong attachment for Felix's doctor, an attractive young woman.
Chip and Ernie conclude that the world is ending.
Bub tries to cover his baldness to impress a woman.
Robbie runs for student council.
Steve must escort the daughter of a visiting dignitary.
Rob takes a shady salesman to court for selling Laura smelly feather pillows.
Buddy and Rob run a shoe store they've invested in after chasing off its only full-time salesman.
Rob and Laura are in a quandary over how Ritchie can protect himself from a girl who's been persistently beating him up at school.
When Rob learns that a song he co-wrote in the army is a radio hit, he starts a fight with an old buddy over authorship rights.
Billie Jo tries to spread love through the valley with a new theory of sensitivity training.

programmes.st: No, No, You Can't Take Her Away
programmes.d: The Bradley's are shaken by the news that a handsome and wealthy male doctor is coming to visit their own Dr. Janet Craig, with intentions of offering her a place at his side at a new practice in Hawaii.
Betty Jo Elliott starts a day nursery to augment the family income.
The Shady Rest hotel is threatened when a railroad detective comes to investigate a forgotten spur line on the property.
Kate uses her charms to keep Homer Bedloe from catching the train to Pixley.

programmes.st: The President Who Came To Dinner
programmes.d: President of the railroad comes to visit the Shady Rest hotel with the intention to terminate the Cannonball's service.
In the first of the 3 part sea maneuvers, Gomer sneaks a cat aboard a Navy ship, unaware there is sensitive Petty Chief Officer who throws all Contraband overboard.
Part 2 of sea maneuvers has Pyle repeatedly goofing up Carter's mission.
Part 3 of Sea Maneuvers, has Carter challenging the Petty Chief Officer to a boxing match not knowing the Chief was the Fleet Champ with 37 knockouts.

While sitting in a restaurant, Gomer witnesses an automobile accident between Sergeant Carter and another driver. When in court Gomer takes the oath seriously to tell the truth, the whole truth and nothing but the truth.
When Gomer's cousin Goober shows up in the barracks and puts on one of Gomer's uniforms and then wanders the base, everyone sees the name Pyle on the uniform and thinks Gomer is losing his mind.

programmes.st: A Groom for Sergeant Carter's Sister
programmes.d: Gomer starts dating Sergeant Carter's sister. Carter is determined to break them up.
A gang of hijackers steals more than they bargained for. The gold they have stolen is mixed with deadly uranium.
Mike and Steve face the ugly task of discovering who has become a syndicate informer.

Someone has been making threatening telephone calls to Joe Mannix, and this mysterious person begins to take shots at him, too -- one of which cuts down Joe's friend Barry Nolan, who runs the photography shop across from Joe's office.
Mannix is hired by the sister of Geoffrey Paradine, a college student who has disappeared. As the episode opens, Mannix is taken off the case because she claims to have found him.
A group of prisoners on death row in a prison near Lawson City stage a takeover, taking as a hostage a guard named Charlie Keefer, who is a friend of Joe Mannix.
Victor Brady, a leader in the electronics business, runs up a gambling debt of nearly $250,000 to a Las Vegas casino. Brady's private plane disappears from the radar on its way back to Los Angeles.

Betty meets a man on a cruise that she's interested in, but when she returns she discovers a murdered man in his motel room who's carrying his identification in his wallet. Barnaby gets involved to unravel the mystery behind the man.

The prime suspect in the beating death of a nightclub owner is a stand-up comic who was fired the night of the murder. J.R. investigates on behalf of the comedian, who professes his innocence-and he also happens to be his good friend.

A hooker who saw a prominent judge pick-up a young girl in North Hollywood the night she died has blackmail in mind. Barnaby tries to clear the girls name because it looked like she was a working girl, and she wasn't.
A friend of Betty's, who volunteered at a school for autistic children is killed. Betty tries to get close to the only witness, a young girl who is almost totally non-verbal.
Five bodies found in Mauna Loa volcano crater due to radioactive poisoning from plutonium exposure. Steve McGarrett investigates to find source on the Island.
Steve McGarrett searches for unknown international assassin whose next target may be a VIP. Murder of CIA agent and hotel PR director lead to investigation.

programmes.st: The Last of the Great Paperhangers
programmes.d: Forger Hunter Hickey steals $14,000 from Five-O, prepares for $100k forgery on bank & Navy. Steve McGarrett tries to stop him.
Tragedy strikes the annual Trans-Pac race from California to Hawaii, bringing Steve McGarrett and his Five-O agents onto the sporty yachting scene in search of a trio of mutineer-murderers.
Wrongly convicted man escapes prison to prove innocence after refusing parole. McGarrett's only clue: claim accepting parole would mean guilt admission.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: It’s Christmastime and an eager journalist from the local Sparta Herald newspaper begs to interview the police force; however, when she twists their stories to fit her negative agenda, the officers learn a hard lesson about the power of the press.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Gillespie and Tibbs investigate a fatal car crash. The driver, Robbie Jeffries, suffered severe injuries in the accident, and his girlfriend Becky was killed. Everyone is surprised when the medical reports show Robbie may have been poisoned.

programmes.st: Hunter: S4 E13 - The Black Dahlia
programmes.d: Lawrence Tierney guest stars as Detective Doyle, who comes out of retirement to help Hunter and McCall investigate the murder of actress-turned-prostitute Elizabeth Short.

programmes.st: Hunter: S4 E14 - Naked Justice, Part 1
programmes.d: Hunter and McCall investigate the mysterious death of a famous movie actress and encounter a surviving sister hungry for the inheritance.
A ratings war sparks a wave of deaths across the big TV networks - a magician impales himself on a bed of spikes, and Dr Danger also turns up dead.
With the latest murder on TV taking place at Community General, Dr. Sloan, Steve, Jesse, and Amanda prepare to solve this case and protect their integrity.

programmes.st: Today Is The Last Day Of The Rest Of My Life
programmes.d: The new attending physician, Kate Delibe, is causing a stir at Community General with her unorthodox methods of care. Delibe assists terminally ill patient George Dugan's suicide against Dr. Sloan's wishes.

A protégé of Walker's is a kickboxing champion who is being pressured by a former champion who lost the title due to steroids. The previous champion tries to plant drugs on Walker's friend and then tries murder.

A Texas Ranger is killed in the line-of-duty. Two officers apply for the open position. Both are almost equally skilled. One candidate is being hunted by her violent ex-husband, and she thinks about dropping out of the application process.

High school athletes are being coaxed to take a hybrid steroid called Powerballs to enhance their sporting skills. However, the drug takes over their brain and makes them oblivious to danger, causing teems to die from the drug.
The criminal that killed Walker's fiancé ten years ago is being released early from prison. He intends to seek revenge on Walker for putting him away by hurting all of Walker's friends.
Innocent acceptance of an apparently menial job as a porter at a swank country club, involves Dr. Richard Kimble in a top secret government experiment.
Kimble falls and lands in the home of a Naturopath and finds himself fighting against bad medical practice and romantic advances from his host's wife.
Kimble makes a careless error disclosing his whereabouts and Lt. Gerard, hastily returning from a vacation with his wife, closes in.
Working behind the iron curtain to destroy the wreckage of a top-secret jet, MacGyver comes to the aid of a renowned Russian psychic who wishes to defect.
MacGyver and old buddy Jack Dalton are arrested and thrown into a labor camp, only to discover they are being used by the local authorities to search for some hidden bank robbery loot.
MacGyver and Nikki are trapped by old nemesis Murdoc and are forced to flee down the side of a sheer rock formation where an old friend of MacGyver's lost her life.
As Lou Summers heads to the comedy club to host Mark's Man of the Year Roast, a driver in a nearby car shoots at him and misses, but Lou doesn't hear it because his hearing aids aren't on.

Dr. Mark Sloan is caught between family and professional loyalties as his brother Stacy, and medical student Daniel, are both implicated in a mysterious series of events that end in an accidental death.
Steve seeks a particular doctor for his ailing back.
Robbie's girlfriend has an attractive, single mother.
With Henry away in New York on business and Alice having to spend the night with Henry's mother, Dennis stays with the Wilsons for a night.
Dennis takes Mr. Wilson's lawn edger without asking, so when Mr. Wilson sees Mrs. Elkins using an edger she recently purchased, he takes it believing it was stolen from him.
Mr. Wilson thinks his property taxes are rising because the school is wasting money on nonessential programs and luxuries.
A famous actress commissions Mr. Wilson to write her life story thinking he is a young, vigorous author with a youthful point of view.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Family Dines Out
programmes.d: Betty has a new friend, Elouise Sanford. Elouise is from an upper class family. Betty is concerned that she will not be able to keep the friendship unless Elouise thinks they are from the same class.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Bud, The Boxer
programmes.d: Eddie Jarvis is the school bully. He challenges Bud to a boxing match.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Betty, Girl Engineer
programmes.d: After a job fair, Betty decides she would like to be an engineer.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Martins and the Coys
programmes.d: Betty and her boyfriend are getting along wonderful until his father and Jim have a fight. After the fight, he refuses to see her ever again.
Jody and Buffy decide to help Emily go to her son Jim's graduation celebration. She wants a new outfit and someone to take her.
One of Buffy's friends tells her it is time to give up her doll, Mrs. Beasley, as it is a child's toy. They go to a toy store where the owner looks like Mrs. Beasley.
Buffy helps a shy friend meet new friends. Buffy throws a party for Angela and her friends, but she experiences some unexpected results.
Buffy, Jody, and their friend Ricky find a great place to play in the neighborhood. Then they find out a parking lot is going to be built in the space.

Cindy studies hard and passes a test to appear on a TV quiz show, but an overconfident Bobby does not. But after she passes, he ego goes out of control. Meanwhile, Mike and Carol make plans for a dinner party.
Bobby lies to his friends that he knows Joe Namath, but they don't believe him. So with Cindy's help, Bobby fakes a serious illness in order to get Namath to come to the house and visit him.
Greg gets Peter to pretend to be an older guy and go with him on a double date, and Mike and Carol prepare to entertain one of Mike's clients from Mexico.
Greg steals the mascot from his rival school the night before the big game, and Mike tries to help him return it before he gets in big trouble.
Marcia, Jan and Peter each get jobs at the local ice cream parlor, each with varying results.

Bobby saves Peter from potential serious injury after he pushes him out of the way of a falling ladder. A grateful Peter offers to become Bobby's "slave for life," something that Bobby takes quick advantage of.
Edith is chosen to appear in a tv commericial but finds herself unable to lie when she begins to doubt the quality of the sponsor's detergent.
Archie refuses to let Edith's elderly aunt move into their spare bedroom, even after she's been turned away by every other relative.
Archie's Place is robbed on Superbowl Sunday, the busiest day of the year.
Archie is jealous when a lonely butcher lavishes attention on Edith.
Mike and Archie have a long talk after they find themself locked in the storeroom of Archie's Place.
Mike and Gloria are sure the romance has gone out of their marriage when even a weekend in the Poconos fails to reignite the spark.
Archie's estranged brother returns, after twenty-nine years, to smooth things over before he enters the hospital for a serious operation.
The Stivics prepare to move to California after Mike is offered a teaching position in Santa Barbara.
When Mama signs up for an open microphone night, another comedian steals all her jokes. She improvises by talking about her family, and the audience bursts out in laughter.
Mama finds an old certificate for 10 shares of stock, which is now worth enough to convene a shareholders' meeting of the company that is about to lay Vint off.
The heavy metal band that Bubba arranges for the homecoming dance turns out to be three girls. Their grandmother's cake recipe and the band are both a hit at the church carnival.
All's fair in love and war when Vint and Naomi get in an argument and Mama and Iola battle it out to grow the winning rose at this year's flower show.
When Mama slips on a roll of pennies in a bank, the family hires a shady lawyer. The attorney convinces Mama she's far more injured than she realizes and to sue for $3.2 million.

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

programmes.t: Mozart Symphony No. 34 & Dvořák Symphony No. 7
programmes.d: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program featuring Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338, and Antonín Dvořák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70.

programmes.t: Works for Lute by J. S. Bach
programmes.d: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017.

Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all the great composer's sixteen string quartets.

programmes.t: LSO Performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky
programmes.d: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance recorded at St Luke's in London on May 18th, 2022; the program consists of a variety of works: D'un Matin de Printemps by Lili Boulanger.

programmes.t: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programmes.d: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with a concert program; under the baton of Christian Schumann, the bands team up and perform from "Lord of the Rings," "The Witcher," "League of Legends" and more.

programmes.t: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programmes.d: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works.

programmes.t: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programmes.d: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.

programmes.t: Piano Duets -- Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o
programmes.d: Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff and Nikolai Kapustin.
Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhausorchester; recorded in Leipzig's Gewandhaus.

programmes.t: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C Minor, Op. 67
programmes.d: Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67 at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programmes.t: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programmes.d: Nikolay Lugansky presents works by Rachmaninoff as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov.

In December 1985, when human bones are discovered in the woods, it puts an end to the search for missing teen David Reed. David's skull fractures point to murder; but it will be decades before investigators can find his killer.
The loving aunt of a close-knit family is stabbed to death in her home. It takes two decades for detectives to discover that a key witness was an imposter--and caused the case to go cold.

A family is torn apart by their grandparents' murders. Two decades later, a cold case detective takes on the case that has haunted him since he was a child--racing to solve it before the family takes matters into their own hands.

After 46 years, LA homicide detectives take a Lover's Lane bandit who also gunned down two police officers into custody. Then, DNA testing helps lead police in Florida to a suspected killer, however, the killer has an identical twin.

The brutal stabbing murder of a Florida woman is solved when police find crucial DNA evidence in spit left on the pavement. And a man is put away for rape and murder when his footprint matches the footprint he left at the crime scene 18 years before.

A killer helps convict himself when he boasts about his crime to prison cellmates; and New Hampshire investigators probing the murder of a pregnant woman found raped, strangled, and dumped into her bathtub, get a new lead.

When 31-year-old real estate appraiser Mike Williams mysteriously vanishes while duck hunting in the Florida swamps in December of 2000, authorities suspect he accidentally drowned. For sixteen years his disappearance remains a mystery.

A North Carolina man looking to clear his conscience gives police the information they need to solve a murder. And Indiana police are baffled by the murder of an 86-year-old woman, found dead in her bedroom.

programmes.st: Bump In The Night/Hitchhike To Murder
programmes.d: A woman who takes down the license plate number of a car that had been following her helps police solve the murder of another young woman.

A detective keeps a murder investigation going for 16 years and finally proves a woman killed her husband in a satanic rite; THE BURNING SECRET: and a rape victim fails to get a conviction on her attacker.

Klan leader Sam Bowers goes on trial for ordering the murder of an African-American storeowner 32 years prior, and investigators reopen the unsolved case of an African-American truck driver who was forced to leap to his death from a bridge by Klan member

In the 1980s, a serial killer prowled the posh streets of Orange County. Police were unaware of the serial attacks until 1996, when DNA revealed the killer's secret and they linked four murders to a single DNA profile.

Detectives are baffled when two young girls are raped, murdered, and dumped in an abandoned house in Akron, Ohio. And a 26-year-old mother of three disappears on Christmas Eve in 1995, but the missing person case goes cold when police can find few clues

A forensic scientist's painstaking examination of a rape kit helps solve the 15-year-old murder of a teenage girl. And when California investigators probe the murder of a 71-year-old man, they get help from the top suspect's former therapist.

Fire investigator Jack Malooly helps crack the case of an arsonist and killer who set fires to collect insurance money, and a prison inmate tells a detective that he can't help him with his current investigation, but knows about a 15-year-old murder.

programmes.st: Left for Dead / On the Case (#126)
programmes.d: A detective in California tracks down a prostitute's killer with the help of a key piece of evidence. And two persistent cold case detectives use DNA to investigate the 1990 murder of a woman and the death of a man killed in a car crash in 1988.

Near what's known as the hanging tree, the mutilated body of Timothy Coggins is found in late 1983. The investigation is thwarted and the case freezes for over 30 years, until a newly elected sheriff vows to bring the killers to justice.
After a nearly disastrous driving lesson, Daria debates whether to switch from glasses to contacts, and Kevin experiments with a new accessory.
When Daria volunteers at a retirement home, she discovers that her tone makes her as unpopular with the senior citizens as it does with her peers.
On a spring day in 2011, Abbi and Ilana meet for the first time.
Abbi's brief return to Soulstice gets interesting when she's given the training opportunity that she's always dreamed of. Meanwhile, Ilana gets a new job at a restaurant.

programmes.st: The Sarah Silverman Program Smellin' of Troy
programmes.d: Troy, Sarah's childhood imaginary friend, returns and lures her into a life of sex and drugs. Steve's song that mocks Brian gains immense popularity.
Sarah campaigns for fake mayoral candidate May Kadoody, and Steve asks Brian to consider marriage.
Adam and Blake's trivia party gets in the way of Ders's career ambitions.
Blake and Ders organize an early bachelor party to send off Adam after he's invited to be someone's wedding date.
After Alice deems Adam's past sales null and void, Blake and Ders fabricate fake leads to boost his spirits.
The guys accept a babysitting gig without realizing that Adam has dosed their smoothies with peyote.
In a flashback to 2008, the guys experience their first day at TelAmeriCorp and help Alice get a leg up at the company.
When TelAmeriCorp starts selling more female-friendly products, the women in the office are promoted and start wielding their new power over the men.
Luther, President Obama's anger translator, reminds everyone who killed Osama bin Laden.
Jordan and Keegan are masters of disguise in Nazi Germany, and two slaves are accused of bigotry.
Commitment looms for Jordan and Keegan after gay marriage is finally legalized.
Jordan and Keegan debate who is blacker, and Bobby McFerrin duels Michael Winslow.

Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny are caught up in the latest fad from Japan: Chinpoko Mon!
To help Cartman win the school spelling bee, Cartman's Mom gives him the Hooked on Monkey Fonics spelling system.
Starvin' Marvin returns to South Park with an alien spaceship and enlists Cartman, Stan, Kyle, and Kenny's help to seek out a new home for his starving people.

The BAU team heads to Yakima, Wash., after the remains of a dozen people are found along a creek bed. Also, they welcome new team member Stephen Walker (Damon Gupton), a seasoned profiler from the Behavioral Analysis Program of the FBI.
The BAU heads to Bethesda, Md., to investigate four murders in the span of three days along the eastern seaboard.
The BAU revisits its origins when they look at one of Rossi and Gideon's old cases to track a killer that got away.

When a 4-year-old girl goes missing while staying with a relative in Mississippi, the BAU uncovers some startling truths as the team races to find the child and bring her to safety. Series star Thomas Gibson directs the episode.
It's literally a race against the clock for the BAU to capture the vigilantes behind a series of attacks taking place every 27 minutes in the nation's capital.
When a young boy who went missing in San Diego on Halloween suddenly reappears one year later, the BAU must work fast when another trick-or-treater disappears under similar circumstances.
When bodies are discovered in public places throughout Boston, the BAU investigates whether the victims used a taxi or ride-share service before their deaths.

The BAU meets their new section chief, Mateo Cruz, who, unbeknownst to them, shares a long work history with JJ. Cruz joins the team as they comb the streets of Baltimore for an UnSub who leaves victims unable to communicate.
The BAU investigates a double homicide and kidnapping in New Hampshire. Also, Rossi's plans to elevate his relationship with Krystall (Gail O'Grady) don't go as planned.

The Centers for Disease Control calls on the BAU when they suspect bioterrorism is behind a series of mysterious deaths in Virginia. Also, Garcia visits her stepbrother, Carlos (Sebastian Sozzi), to take care of a difficult family issue. (TV-14 L, V)
The team searches for Everett Lynch and his daughter; Spencer visits with his mother.

When the daughters of Bruce Morrison, a writer whose wife mysteriously vanished a year ago, go missing on the anniversary of their mother's disappearance, the BAU is brought in to study Morrison as a possible suspect.
When a young boy goes missing from his home in St. Louis, the BAU reinvestigates a similar cold case to search for the UnSub.
After a father and daughter get kidnapped, a former foe returns with very specific demands.
As Hotch fights for his life due to complications from his stabbing at the hands of George Foyet, a.k.a. "The Reaper," he experiences visions of his late wife, Haley, and his nemesis, Foyet.
The BAU is called when the New Orleans P.D. discovers a mass grave inside a vandalized above-ground crypt in a local cemetery. (TV-14 V)

When the BAU is called to Texas to consult on the murders of prostitutes, evidence points to killings with religious overtones. But as they delve further into the investigation, the team could put their lives at risk.

Dr. Mike is shot point blank by a man with a grudge against doctors.
Colleen finds herself the subject of a fatal attraction.
Dr. Mike is sworn to secrecy when she learns that Loren plans to move away for good.

Adam frames Alexis for the poisoning incident, and Blake threatens to take the story public; Mark attacks Krystle; Denver-Carrington's publicist Tracy is disappointed that Krystle has been appointed department head.

Jeff accuses Alexis of attempting to murder him and reclaims his stock; Mark is hired as Alexis' bodyguard; Dex Dexter, the son of a board member, proposes that he and Alexis form a business alliance.
Dex continues his efforts to win Alexis; Jeff learns Adam raped Kirby; Krystle relishes her own publicity post; Fallon meets a dashing millionaire at the track.
Dex beats Alexis to an oil contract; Jeff confronts Adam about Kirby's pregnancy; Krystle accepts Blake's marriage proposal.
Blake and Krystle are to wed.

Adam proposes marriage to Kirby, who intends to divorce Jeff; Tracy persuades Krystle to give her the company credit cards and confidential files; Peter makes a pass at Claudia; and Krystle and Blake are remarried.
A stranger greets little Danny by name; worried, Claudia moves the family into the mansion; Peter DeVilbis's architect hints at the playboy's drug problem; Kirby's hand swells uncontrollably.

Kirby's health problems continue; Peter urges Fallon to try cocaine; Tracy sabotages Krystle at the office to gain Blake's favor; Allegre, the racehorse, is stolen; Claudia receives violets from her late husband.
Blake receives a ransom note for the return of his horse; Peter announces Fallon will be his wife; Dex and Alexis mix business with pleasure; Kirby suffers a seizure.

Blake grows suspicious of Peter DeVilbis; Claudia receives more violets from 'Lancelot'; Adam tells Blake the truth of the poisoning incident; after suffering a seizure, Kirby undergoes emergency surgery and loses her baby.

Allegre is returned, and Blake's suspicions about Peter's involvement are founded; Tracy orchestrates a press campaign to ruin Krystle; learning her fiancé has left the country, Fallon dashes from the hotel and is struck by a truck.
Peter DeVilbis, caught while trying to leave the country, is arrested for possession of drugs and jailed; Blake is offered a political post; Fallon regains consciousness and learns she is paralyzed.
Alexis attempts to bribe Kirby to prevent her from marrying Adam; Claudia receives another package from her late husband; Fallon remains unable to walk, until her child's life is in danger.

Krystle learns she is pregnant; Fallon suffers from painful headaches; Claudia and Steven visit Matthew's accident site in Peru; once home, however, Claudia receives a phone call from her late husband.
Alexis makes a plan to upset Blake's business deal with Rashid Ahmed; Tracy attempts to seduce Blake and is fired; Steven grows suspicious of Dex, who places a mysterious phone call to Claudia.

Dex finds Alexis with Rashid and turns to Tracy for comfort; learning the reasons behind her father's death, Kirby buys a gun; the mysterious caller turns out to be a tape-recorded message; Alexis moves ahead with her plan to ruin Blake.

Kirby learns the truth behind her father's suicide; Krystle tells a stunned Alexis of her pregnancy; Fallon and Jeff announce they will remarry. Blake is planning to attack a nation involved in the China Seas Deal.
The team all face psychiatric evaluation, and Jess hunts for a missing legal secretary.
A federal prosecutor is kidnapped; Nicole and Antonio's relationship reaches crisis point.
The team searches for the protagonist of a school hostage situation.
Antonio, Jess and Colin forsake their vacation to help Nicole investigate the disappearance of her nephew.
Tensions flare at Dondre and Janelle's over-the-top party; Johnny forces Tal to face the truth about who he is.
Poppy and Janelle open up to one another; Rigo and Dondre grapple with the events of the party.
Rigo goes viral; King makes a big reveal to Poppy.
Sage Odom's tour auditions get underway; Uncle Al tries to save the twins; Colette and East-O's turbulent past comes to a head.
Realizing what it takes to become professional dance squad; Rigo has questions after Eart-o's death.
The rivalry between Tal and Zo comes to a head; Davis meets Odalie's parents.
The news of Grace Greenleaf's return to Memphis breeds tension.
Grace's moving back to Memphis is motivated by vengeance for her sister's death; she struggles to work in the family's church.

programmes.st: We Shall See Him As He Is
programmes.d: Jacob and Kerissa realize what their marriage has become; Grace goes on an uncomfortable date; Senator Banks looks into the church's finances.
When the mayor cashes in a favor, the Bishop is left in a tough spot that could split the church; Grace is blackmailed; Charity can't keep a secret.
Grace and the Bishop find themselves in opposition; Lady Mae tries to mend fences while Kerissa is pushed to her limit; Kevin further explores his sexuality.
The Bishop pushes Grace to deal with her feelings concerning the pulpit; Lady Mae admits her blame in Faith's death; Kevin's advise to Charity backfires.
As Chief Council, Mac juggles a lot of tasks for the Greenleaf clan; church complications, Grace and the appearance of his father send Mac on a course that could threaten his status.
Amidst public outcry, Grace reaches out to Officer Nelson; Noah evades Lady Mae's questions; Lady Mae encourages the Bishop to reveal a secret.

Dr. Mike and Sully are traveling through dangerous Indian country when their stagecoach is robbed, and they are abandoned.

Dr. Mike discovers a lump in Dorothy's breast and tries to convince her to have surgery. Hank tries Ladies Night at the saloon, and Jake and Loren have a plan to get free drinks. Colleen deals with hurtful boyish pranks from classmates.
Dr. Mike has a hard time accepting Dorothy's decision not to have the surgery that will save her life. Jake tries to escape the two men who kidnapped him.
The town's Christmas spirit is in question when a family who are Jewish immigrants moves to town.
Sully is appointed Indian agent to the Cheyenne and approaches it in an idealistic fashion. When the food intended for the tribe is diverted and illegal alcohol is plentiful, Sully becomes angry.
A newspaper report of a comet's imminent collision with Earth causes hysteria in town over the end of the world.
Sam Lindsay, an older independent woman, decides to end her medical treatment and take off into the wilderness.

programmes.st: Cooper Vs Quinn, Medicine Woman, Part 1
programmes.d: Colleen and Brian's biological father Ethan returns to town with a new wife, intending to take the children away from Dr. Quinn.

programmes.st: Cooper Vs Quinn, Medicine Woman, Part 2
programmes.d: Colleen and Brian run away to keep their father from taking them away from Dr. Mike and Sully. After they are found, it's discovered Colleen has developed pneumonia. Dr. Mike realizes she has to let them go to save them.
The town puts on a production of Romeo and Juliet. Brian tries to learn what love is so he can write a paper for school.
The angels help a distraught couple deal with a family tragedy that threatens to destroy their marriage
The angels converge on a small town in Texas to witness a Christmas miracle
Monica must convince a successful young attorney to give up an obsessive love for the man who ruined her life
Monica tries to convince a cynical network television executive to produce a show about angels
The angels intervene when the lifelong rivalry between two sibling skiers (guest stars David Lascher and Sean Murray) culminates in tragedy. With Roma Downey and Della Reese.
The angels help a young girl with dreams of becoming an Olympic ice skater overcome her criminal past
The devil disguises himself as Monica to trick a desperate man into selling his soul, forcing Monica into a face-off with her evil twin

When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.

When one of the US Air Force’s most modern tactical aircraft crashes in the sea near Malta, the CIA dispatches their best agent to salvage the plane's advanced weapons system before it falls into enemy hands.

Ninjitsu master Frank Dux journeys to Hong Kong to enter the Kumite, the Olympics of martial arts, and meets a beautiful American reporter. Before long he must face Chong-Li, a vicious Korean master of Tae Kwan Do, in a climactic fight to the finish.

Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

Jean-Claude Van Damme is Lyon Gaultier, a deserter in the French Foreign Legion who travels to the USA and enters the gory world of bare-knuckled street fighting in order to make money to save his brother's life and family.
Identical twins are separated at six months and raised on different continents. They reunite twenty-five years later to avenge the murder of their parents and reclaim their stolen family fortune.
A woman reporter discovers a Defense Department project to create androids from the bodies of Vietnamese soldiers, to be then used as an elite anti-terrorism unit.
Based on the popular video game, this adventure stars martial arts star Jean-Claude Van Damme as a commando leading an elite team of street fighters against the forces of an evil general.
Max Walker, an officer for a security agency that regulates time travel, must fend for his life against a shady politician who's intent on changing the past to control the future.

Charlie and Itchy are given the assignment of finding a rambunctious pup a home. But the little guy is a terror, with a massive appetite to boot! But when things get t0o much, Charlie and Itchy come up with a plan to deal with the little mutt.

Itchy is 'dognapped' by Maxine, a socially challenged rich girl who thinks Itchy is her only friend. Charlie attempts to break his friend out of his prison, but when he finally gets in, he suddenly revels in the wealth. Why Hurry?  Free eats!

When Itchy falls in love with a beautiful show dog named Bess, he asks for Charlie's help in wooing her. But when Bess falls for Charlie instead, Itchy finds out and calls it quits with his partner and friend! Can friendship survive true love?

Charlie and Itchy meet David, who'll spend his birthday in school. Charlie thinks it's awful and decides to break David out of class to give him the best birthday ever. They sneak David out of study hall and proceed to have a wonderful day.
Scott's family album of werewolves gets mixed up in the back of Mick's car. He and his friend Stiles hunt it down in order to protect the Howard family secret.
A werewolf hunter comes to the town of Wolverton. Scott and his family must find and warn Grandpa, who is hunting turkey in the woods.
Scott tries to earn money to pay for an electric guitar. He helps at his dad's shop, but finds raising money is a lot more difficult than he expected.
Scott and his family mysteriously become unable to control their wolf-outs and worry that the town monster, that has been covered in recent news reports, is actually them.

programmes.st: The Senses-Shattering Adventures of Captain Harvtastic
programmes.d: Harvey lacks the courage to show his comic book to the great comic book creator, King Kirby. Sabrina decides to give Harvey a wishing star in hopes that he'll wish for courage.
The Student of the Year winner will be announced soon and Sabrina and Gem are tied to win. Gem uses her money to win the contest so Sabrina uses magic to make Gem lose.
Sabrina, desperate to earn money for an upcoming concert, baby sits the terror twins. Hilda, Zelda and Uncle Quigley warn her that she's just not ready but Sabrina is adamant.

programmes.st: No Time to Be a Hero
programmes.d: Harvey mistakenly thanks Sabrina for saving his life. She feels bad for the unearned praise she is getting. Sabrina, with Salem's help travels back in time to redo everything.

Cleo's sister Kim finds her diary and thinks that Cleo and her friends are 'evil mermaids' and she plans to tell everyone. Meanwhile, Lewis goes to Mako Island to find out more about what happened to the girls.

Rikki gains an admirer in Emma’s younger brother Elliot when she saves him from drowning. She lets him down hard causing him to run away and hide in the fernery. The girls find him just as the watering system is about to start…

The effects of the full moon turns Emma into a carefree, wild mermaid. At her father’s birthday party she’s the opposite to her usual, organised self. Can the other girls stop her before all is revealed?
A charismatic newcomer, Dr. Denman, tempts Lewis with the promise of scientific fame and fortune. Will he abandon his friends and risk their secret, all in the name of science?

Kasimir and Gus get into a competition over who will be first to get a date for the upcoming school dance. Kasimir meets a cute boy in a magic-novelty shop and secretly uses REAL magic to impress him.

Cassy gets an identity crisis when, in Shapeshifting 101, she's the kid who can't change shape. But there's no time to worry about it because the kids encounter a bottled IMP from the Centre of The Earth.

No matter how hard Gus works on a shrinking formula for Potions Class, it comes out wrong. Frustrated, he thinks about cheating and turning in a commercially made one. Meanwhile, in the underground realm of the greedy Scavenger Imps.
Something strange is happening: knives can't cut butter, bramble bushes are becoming soft (even Gus's comic timing is off). When Cassy and Verne are sent into the mortie village to buy bread.
Rikki uses her abilities as a mermaid to earn some quick cash, but when she accidentally becomes involved in a fish smuggling operation, she sets out to get her revenge.

Rikki enters a short film contest on the theme of 'Heroes' and decides to capture some nice underwater footage with her 'abilities'. Meanwhile, Emma is interviewing her mum and Zane and Lewis are planning to rennact Dr. Bennet's windsurfing record.

Byron asks Emma for help with training the school's swimming team and Emma has some trouble deciding whether or not to help out in her current situation. Meanwhile, Lewis continues to experiment on the girls, which annoys Rikki.

Rikki sets Cleo up at a karaoke contest as a joke, where she is humiliated due to her lack of talent. However, her singing ability undergoes a dramatic change when, in spite of the girls' precautions, she is hypnotized by the full moon.
When the mysterious, old Miss Chatham's boat and home is declared unseaworthy, Emma invites her over to stay. Zane gets trapped on the sinking boat and Emma tries to save him but he sees a tail.

Cleo's 16th birthday is approaching and she thinks that her father is going to throw another embarrasing birthday party. Meanwhile, Zane tries to find the 'sea monster' that he saw when he almost drowned.
Marshall needs to be saved from daylight savings (which isn't in effect in Eerie) after he resets his time and falls into a dimension always one hour behind.
An artistic girl's sketches take on a life of their own. Realizing her capability, she attempts to draw the perfect family.
Marshall and Simon think they've finally found someone who will believe them - a traveling professor of the 'parabelievable.' But should they be believing him?
During Errie's annual Tornado day, Matt Frewer drops in as a wacky meteorologist whom Marshall helps battle Tornado Bob.

Questing through the dark, thick "dangerous" forest on a dire search for food, our starving brothers Chuck and Melvin come across an eerie Trading Post where they trade off Chuck's beloved horse Splendour for a bag of magic beans.
When surfer dudes Ben and Mike mistakenly travel to Austria instead of Australia, they find themselves aboard the midnight run of the Translyvania Express railway.
Gary is like any other 14-year old boy yearning for some privacy.
Selfish eight year old Shauna doesnt like to share, especially with her five year old sister Katie.

Sabrina’s tired of sharing Harvey with all of his extra activities: sports practice, science club, after-school job at the local market, etc. But when she casts a spell making her Harvey’s top priority, she gets more than she planned on.
Frasier buys Martin a telescope as a gift, leading to a long-distance relationship with a woman named Irene.
Frasier is furious when he learns that his newest art purchase is actually a fake.
Frasier faces a personal and professional dilemma when he begins dating the ex-girlfriend of one of his radio show callers.
When Frasier and Niles see their father dining with an old family friend, they conclude that Martin once had an affair with the woman.
When Frasier is lured into doing on-air endorsements, his professional credibility comes under fire.
When Frasier contributes to the rumor mill, he causes Bulldog to lose his job.
When a seemingly healthy colleague dies unexpectedly, Frasier becomes obsessed with his own mortality.

programmes.st: Miracle on Third or Fourth Street
programmes.d: When his son cannot spend the holidays with him, a melancholy Frasier learns the true spirit of Christmas from a group of strangers.
Martin is furious with Frasier when he spills the secrets of his father's love life on the air.
Frasier looks forward to a hot date with a beautiful model who "bought" him in a celebrity bachelor auction.

programmes.st: You Can't Tell a Crook by his Cover
programmes.d: After Frasier claims he can spot a criminal in a crowd, Martin challenges him to identify the ex-con in his poker group.

programmes.st: The Show Where Lilith Comes Back
programmes.d: After finding a long-lost letter of reconciliation from Frasier, Lilith comes to Seattle and tries to rekindle their relationship.
Niles faces the ultimate temptation when he and Daphne are trapped in his home during a violent storm.
When Frasier's show is nominated for a local broadcasting award, Roz suggests they "persuade" the judges by plying them with gifts.
Frasier learns that sentiment is more important than style after he accidentally loses his father's old armchair.
Panicked at the prospect of growing old, Frasier seeks solace in the pursuit of a pretty young woman who shows an interest in him.
Frasier's attempts at a father-son vacation turn into an outrageous road trip, with Niles and Daphne along for the ride.
Frasier  and Niles attempt to join forces  on a book, but wind up doing more fighting than writing.
While home sick with the flu, Frasier becomes paranoid that everyone, including his own brother Niles, is out to take over his show.
When Niles asks Frasier if he's happy after his first year back in Seattle, the question opens up a comical and revealing family dialogue.
Frasier discovers that a steamy best seller was based on his affair with an older woman.
After Eddie fathers a litter of illegitimate pups, Frasier goes behind Martin's back to get the dog neutered.
Frasier's plan to "fix up" Daphne with his new boss goes awry when Frasier learns his secret.
After witnessing a woman give birth, Niles decides it's time to practice his parenting skills -- on a sack of flour!
Frasier and Niles are upset when they learn that they're investors in the company slated to demolish their father's favorite hangout.
Frasier endures the wrath of Seattle residents after he "slams" the city in an on-air tirade.
After Martin announces his support for a radical political candidate, Frasier and Niles decide to back the main opponent.
Frasier's budding relationship is put to the test when he bumps into his ex-wife, Lilith, while on vacation with his new love.
Jealousy rears its ugly head when Frasier bumps into Lilith and her new boyfriend while vacationing with his new girlfriend.
Martin finds it hard to "forgive and forget" when he runs into a former police buddy who's in the hospital.
Frasier and Niles confront the bullies who used to torment them in junior high school.
Roz and Frasier discover that breaking up is hard to do after Roz takes a new job as Bulldog's producer.
Frasier plays amateur sleuth after becoming caught up in Martin's obsession with a twenty-year-old unsolved murder.
Chris Farley, Nicollette Sheridan, and Chris Rock star in this comic crash of cultures about a talentless Ninja determined to save a mysterious damsel in distress.

Cheech and Chong fly to Amsterdam for a film festival. Soon after, they take Dolly Parton and Burt Reynolds' place in a limo, leading them to a press conference and a music performance. They throw in some sketches as well.
The precinct thinks that Sledge and Dori have slept together when all that appears on a surveillance tape is them drunk and in bed.

Sledge's ex-wife Susan Hilton marries his best high school friend and forces Sledge to think about his lifestyle. A spoof of The Graduate song Mrs. Robinson. His ex-wife is played by David Rasche's real-life wife, Heather Lupton.
The team finds out that they have to be drug tested, so they try to stay sober for three days but can't function normally.
In response to last season's dismal, Coach Daniels brings in a new star QB who turns out to be a loose cannon, taking Alex on a dangerous adventure.
Mark helps Leonard with his magic wand issues, and Twayne Boneraper meets his two-dimensional soulmate.
Mark and Randall spend Halloween with Callie's family, and Leonard tries to find people to live in a haunted house.
Frank makes a powerful friend at a football game. Frank's move into management stirs up trouble with his old work pals.
Christmas Eve turns chaotic as Frank's deal to avoid a strike hits a last-minute snag and Bill's first stint as an altar boy leads to trouble.

A very important meeting for Frank doesn't quite go down as smoothly as he had hoped. Sue begins to find that she no longer enjoys the plastic storage container parties as she used to and finds herself dreaming of other diversions.

Greg Davies returns as the Taskmaster as five new comedic competitors tackle a raft of tricky tasks with today's episode including a potato-throwing moment set to make television and sporting history.
Greg Davies judges the task attempts of our five funny foes which today includes Jon Richardson's horrific take on Three Blind Mice as he strives to create the best music video for a nursery rhyme.
Douglas becomes a Spaceologist, Roy's life is changed by a bad back, and Jen gets involved with a rock band.
Roy gets obsessed with his latest girlfriend's sad family history, and Jen tells an absolute whopper to get some attention.
Garcia shoots a Dungeons & Dragons player, and Junior accidentally gets married during a sting operation.
Reno District Attorney Mike Powers investigates the Sheriff's Department.
Jones and Garcia enjoy their undercover stakeout a little too much, and Dangle and Clemmy start the department's first rock band.
District Attorney Mike Powers concludes his investigation of the Sheriff's Department, while Terry the prostitute takes off in Reno's police helicopter.
Yearning to fit in yet wanting to be themselves, Lindsay Weir, her brother Sam, and a diverse group of friends struggle to get through 1980 at William McKinley High School.
With her parents going out of town, Lindsay attempts to win the freaks' approval by throwing a party - but Sam and his friends are worried when they learn there will be beer at the party.
When the guys take three young trainees under their wing, the office prank situation gets seriously out of hand.
Bill and Montez transport a mysterious briefcase through the Chinatown underworld.
When Alice makes the office sell a terrible product that her dad invented, the guys discover they can use it as a cover to deal weed over the phone.
The guys throw their own version of Coachella to impress some girls.

Garfield accidentally winds up on an airplane going to the North Pole. / When the rain stops, Roy follows the rainbow for the pot of gold. / Jon has too many remotes, so goes to buy one brand new universal remote that will work on all his electronics.

programmes.st: Forget Me Not/U.S Acres: I Like Having You Around!/Sales Resistance
programmes.d: Garfield loses his memory and becomes "nice."/Bo moves out of the house just as big storm hits./The worlds' greatest salesman shows up.
Jon’s new next-door neighbor is a cat hater and Garfield has to find out why. All of the farmyards are caught in a repeating cycle of zany bits.

programmes.st: Mind Over Matter/Orson at the Bat/The Multiple-Choice Cartoon
programmes.d: Jon takes Garfield and Odie to see the mind reader Suami Pastrami. Orson and the gang are playing baseball when he gets hit on the head and dreams his team is playing against his brothers. Garfield gives a multiple choice quiz.

The heroes try to prevent the Gestapo from sending Klink and Schultz to the Russian front.

For Colonel Hogan's birthday his crew decides to give him one ammunition dump freshly destroyed.

Lucy decides to try a new look, despite her husband Ricky's objections. She borrows a black wig from her hairdresser Roberta, who tells Lucy it makes her look like a whole different person. With that in mind, Lucy decides to play a little trick on Ricky.

Ricky becomes interested in a diner that is for sale so the Ricardos and the Mertzes all buy it together. Right away, Ethel and Fred feel they are doing all the work while Lucy and Ricky have all the fun.
Lucy's mother writes to ask if she and her husband "Xavier" would be so kind as to entertain "a friend's roommate's cousin's middle boy, Ernest" when he visits New York.

Lucy and Ricky, tired of the extensive visit by their cousin Tennessee Ernie, try to get rid of the likeable character by pleading poverty. Ernie then tries to help his gracious hosts out of their fiscal desperation.

Golf pro, Jimmy Demaret, visits Lucy and Ethel on the green to show them how the game is really played after they're misled by Ricky and Fred. Lucy and Ethel decide they'll learn how to play golf to spend more time with their husbands.

Ricky books a two-month summer job in Maine and decides to take Lucy and Little Ricky. For the summer, they want to sublet their apartment at a profit, but their friends and landlords, the Mertzes, are not in favor.

Ricky Ricardo hires business manager Mr. Hickox to solve the family budget problems. Lucy, dissatisfied with her new $5 per month allowance, manages to find a loophole in the business manager's system.

Lucy agrees to help her neighbor Fred Mertz impress an old vaudeville buddy who's in town for a visit. Lucy poses as the Mertzes maid "Bessie" to make Barney Kurtz believe Fred hit it big in real estate.
Lucy feigns a crisis to test Ricky's love after hearing a story about a woman whose husband ignored her pleas for help while being robbed—she assumes Ricky would turn his back on her too.
Lucy plays Cupid and tries to bag a bachelor for a husband-hungry girlfriend. Lucy organizes an evening to show her unmarried friends, Dorothy and Sam, how wonderful marriage is.

Ricky agrees reluctantly to host a new television show, sponsored by Phipps Department Store, and learns they'd like him to host with his wife Lucy. When Lucy finds out that Ricky didn't want her in the show, she sets out to sabotage the program.
When Ben Benjamin arrives at the Ricardos' apartment, Lucy mistakes Ben Benjamin, a Hollywood talent scout, for a burglar and nearly ruins Ricky's chance for a film career.
Lucy sees Ricky's screen test as an opportunity to get discovered as a new movie star.

Lucy Ricardo meets her Spanish-speaking mother-in-law for the first time and her efforts to be a gracious host turn disastrous. Lucy's inability to speak Spanish and her in-law's inability to understand Lucy's pantomime erects a wall of misunderstanding.

Despite the reservations of her husband, Lucy decides to help Fred pick out a birthday present for Ethel. She picks out a pair of toreador pants, which Ethel thinks are unflattering as well as too big.
Ricky Ricardo paces the floor, awaiting word from Hollywood about his screen test. Lucy can't use the phone for fear the line will be busy when Ben Benjamin tries to call for Ricky.

A movie contract for Ricky necessitates a change in scenery and the hanging of a "for rent" sign on the Ricardos' New York home. The Mertzes, willing to give up tenants but not friends, sign on for the trip.

For their trip out west, Ricky buys a new car to replace the old, beat-up one Fred bought. Lucy convinces her husband to teach her how to drive it. After one driving lesson, Ricky is a harried and beaten man.

Lucy's mother wants to join the Ricardos on their road trip out west. As anticipated, Ricky blows his stack when he hears that Lucy's mother wants to go along, and continues to complain that everyone's going on the trip.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes have a hard time finding accommodations that will please everyone on their trip to California. Ricky is driving and sacrifices his passengers' appetites for the sake of making mileage.
The Ricardos and the Mertzes are arrested when they're caught speeding in Bent Fork, Tennessee. Although Ricky just wants to pay the fine, Lucy protests that they are being treated unfairly.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes, on the last leg of their NY-to-Hollywood motor trek, stop at Ethel's hometown of Albuquerque, New Mexico. Under the impression that Ethel has been called to Hollywood by the movies, the townsfolk give her the star treatment.

After five weeks on the road driving across the country, the Ricardos and the Mertzes arrive at their destination – Hollywood. With stars in her eyes, Lucy heads for the Brown Derby, a restaurant frequented by celebrities, with Ethel and Fred in tow.

Lucy is jealous when Ricky is asked to pose with five beautiful starlets for publicity photos and tries to get herself in on the action by inserting herself into every shot. Lucy is even more upset when Ricky goes to his first Hollywood premiere.

Lucy is desperate to appear in a Hollywood movie after hearing the Mertzes have bit parts in an upcoming feature. She sets out to be "discovered" and lands a part in an MGM musical. She plays a showgirl in a glamorous nightclub scene but has some trouble.

Lucy convinces Ricky to allow her to buy a Don Loper dress so she'll fit in with the Hollywood scene. Lucy and Ethel hit the couturier's salon but soon realize the dresses are way out of their price range.

Lucy arrives in Hollywood with Little Ricky to meet her husband and his new press agent, who intends on making Ricky the "Cuban Liberace." Charlie Pomerantz plans a publicity stunt he hopes will get Ricky into Hedda Hopper's gossip column.

Lucy learns her husband's film Don Juan will be shelved and works frantically with the Mertzes and Mrs. McGillicuddy to prevent it from happening. Together they write hundreds of fan letters and dress up as members of the Ricky Ricardo Fan Club.

Lucy has agreed to write an article entitled "What It's Like To Be Married To Ricky Ricardo" for a magazine when she learns from Ricky's press agent that Ricky is going to host a TV show. Lucy desperately wants to appear on the show with Ricky.

Ricky forgot the date of his 15th anniversary and desperately wires the records department in Greenwich, Connecticut where they were married to find out. In his defense, Ricky tells Lucy that he's already planned a big "surprise" anniversary party.
Lucy learns a movie star, Cornel Wilde, is staying in the penthouse directly above the Ricardos' apartment and sets out to catch a glimpse of the handsome actor.

Lucy and Ricky, and Fred and Ethel are fed up with each other's annoying habits and decide they all need a break. They split up for a brief vacation and Lucy and Ethel decide they'll go to Palm Springs for a girls-only good time.

Lucy's friend Caroline Abbleby decides she'll pay Lucy a visit while on her way to Hawaii, and can't wait for Lucy to introduce her to all the stars she has supposedly befriended. Lucy's only solution is to trick her friend and set the stage for deceit.

The artists team up to tattoo underwater ocean scenes on the backs of their canvases' hands, and a stained-glass tattoo sparks an explosive elimination.

Husbands are being lured away from their village by a beautiful demon. Their wives ask Miroku to defeat the demon.
Sango goes back to the slayer village in order to fix her Hiraikotsu, and Kagome goes back to the well so she can return to the present day.
Inuyasha is able to escape from the miniature garden with the help of Miroku and the others, and goes to save Kagome.
Sango returns to the demon slayer village and repairs her Hiraikotsu. She also lays her father and her comrades' ashes to rest.

Jane has made big plans to celebrate Mateo's first birthday, but things start to fall apart when she learns there might be an issue with her wedding venue.
After moving up the wedding day, Jane and Michael find all their carefully made plans thrown into chaos. To make matters worse, Jane is unhappy with her current graduate thesis.

Jane discovers that Michael was shot and finds herself having to make difficult choices. With Rafael focused on keeping Mateo safe, Anezka, who is pretending to be Petra, "helps" the cops with their investigation.

When Rafael finally admits that he is over Jane, their co-parenting style is tested when they argue over what the best preschool is for Mateo. Xo is paranoid about Alba finding out her secret and what it will do to their relationship.
Jane continues to work on her thesis and she decides to add Alba's estranged sister to the narrative, much to Alba's dismay. Rogelio tries for his chance at being an American crossover star.

Jane and Michael's housewarming party hits a snag when they discover they are being evicted for not paying their rent. Rogelio is still trying to break into American television, but needs some unusual help from Rafael.

Jane convinces Alba to let her read the letters from her estranged sister, but under the condition Jane doesn't reach out to her family. Rafael is starting to suspect that something is different with Petra.

When Jane's cousin unexpectedly shows up at her door, Jane questions her own less than spontaneous life. Xo finds the perfect location for her dance studio, but it happens to be near her ex-boyfriend, Bruce.

When Alba makes Jane feel guilty for not attending church, Jane decides she wants to bring Mateo against Rafael's wishes. Rafael unlocks a long lost memory of his mother, which could be a clue in the Mutter case. Rogelio hires a matchmaker.

Jane finds it difficult to stop meddling in other people's relationships, especially Xo's and Rafael's. Rogelio makes an unorthodox agreement with his matchmaker. Petra goes to great lengths to find out if Rafael is working against her.

Jane and Michael are both feeling the pressure - Jane with turning in the perfect novel and Michael with passing his upcoming test. Rogelio invites everyone to the last day of filming for his telenovela, but he is not pleased with the ending.

When Jane realizes that she and Michael are both stressed out, they decide to recreate their first date to help them relax. Rogelio makes a big scene on the red carpet of his film premiere and his rant goes viral.

Working in publishing is not what Jane thought it would be, until she learns about a showcase for up and coming writers. With Petra helming the Marbella, she decides to rebrand the hotel, but quickly butts heads with the rival hotel next door.

When Jane is offered a book deal, she thinks her prayers have been answered and debates quitting her publishing job. After suffering from panic attacks, Jane is ready to get to the root of the problem. Rogelio and Xo work on fixing their friendship.

When Jane messes up at Mateo's school, Petra convinces Jane to help with the preschool fundraiser to get in the good graces of the preschool's director. Jane is excited for her first meeting with her editor, but it does not go the way she expected.

Jane feels guilty that she isn't around for Mateo as much as she would like, so she decides to run for Room Mom against none other than perfect mom, Petra. Alba tries to impress her crush, but it doesn't go well.

Jane is finally ready to get back in the dating game so she enlists the help of Rafael and Petra, but it seems they have their own issues to work on. Alba takes Xo and Jane's advice about being an independent woman when it comes to Jorge.

programmes.d: With the pressures of high school in their near future, CJ and her two best friends decide to embark on a series of middle school adventures while they can still take risks and have fun.

For generations, the Murphy family has been Jinxed with a 100-year old curse, if anything can go wrong it will go wrong. Meg Murphy sets out on a journey to break the curse and get the normal life she's always dreamed of living.

When an introverted 17-year-old switches schools, the most popular girl mistakes him for a vampire. His supernatural persona helps him rule the school, but as word spreads, the truth becomes harder to hide!

The ninja try to flee from the rest of the Stone Army that has been brought to life by the Devourer’s toxic venom - and things get a lot worse when Garmadon arrives with a ‘Helmet of Darkness’ and seizes control of the Stone Army.

The Ninjas, Lloyd, Sensei Wu and Misako journey to the Dark Island to find a ‘Temple of Light’ that can restore the Ninjas’ elemental powers but are attacked by Starteeth (barnacle-like star fish) that start eating through their ship.

After battling off Garmadon’s Stone Army, the Ninjas finally arrive at the Temple of Light where they harness their pure elemental powers, concentrating them onto Lloyd who becomes more powerful than he ever imagined.

When the Ninjas’ attempt to return Garmadon’s ‘Helmet of Darkness’ to its perch at the Celestial Clock in order to prevent the final battle between Lloyd and his father from beginning fails, a Super Weapon is created that can destroy all of Ninjago.
When Garmadon uses his new Super-Weapon to turn Jamakai Village evil, he unwittingly unsettles the balance, allowing the spirit of the Overlord to cross over and possesses his body.

A great darkness has fallen upon Ninjago as Garmadon’s Super-Weapon has turned it evil but Lloyd and the Ninjas discover that light is more powerful than dark - and the final and ultimate battle is on.

After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd.

programmes.st: The Art of the Silent Fist
programmes.d: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord’s evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go.

The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd.

programmes.st: The Curse of the Golden Master
programmes.d: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas’ search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd.

Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive
Lloyd is free but Pythor and the Overlord are nowhere to be found. However the Ninja have a cryptic clue to their next plan - something called Codename: Arcturus. But what is it?

Back in Ninjago it is time for the final battle with the reborn, god-like Overlord. The stakes have never been greater and one ninja must make the ultimate sacrifice to try to stop his reign of destruction

Back in Ninjago it is time for the final battle with the reborn, god-like Overlord. The stakes have never been greater and one ninja must make the ultimate sacrifice to try to stop his reign of destruction

When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend.

On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.”
In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole.
Chen pits everyone against each other in a ludicrous roller skating event called Thunderblade  and all contestants team up against the Ninja.
The Ninja have a secret alliance of elemental fighters, Cole has found Zane and Nya is a spy within Chen’s Kabuki to figure out what nefarious plot Chen is up to.
Nya has proof of Chen’s plan but he entices the contestants to hunt her down with promises to advance the winner, forcing the Ninja in a race to get to her first.

After stealing the remaining contestant’s powers, Chen only needs Lloyd’s power to complete the spell and knowing his daughter has feelings for Kai, Chen tries to enlist the Fire Ninja by promising to share secrets about his parents.

Chen has failed to bring the return of the Serpentine War but Clouse reveals there’s another way – his daughter has the ability to absorb the power of every fighter she comes across, so she can complete the ceremony.
The Ninja reunite with Wu and turn to the aid of a shrunken Pythor in order to figure out how to defeat the unstoppable Anacondrai.

The Ninja and fighters discover there’s a strategic location called The Corridor of Elders where they can make their last stand against Chen’s Anacondrai army... but even with the new Destiny Bounty, their forces still aren’t strong enough.

Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission…
When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu’s staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja

The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn’t keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks.
The Ninja hear of another way to learn Airjitzu - from the ghost of Sensei Yang at his haunted temple - but there’s a warning; if you are trapped in it by sunrise, you will become a ghost, too.

Now that the Ninja know Airjitzu, they get briefed about how the next stage to finding the tomb is to get ‘The Sword of Sanctuary’ from Cloud Kingdom, which can only be reached from the top of the Wailing Alps.

In Cloud Kingdom, a realm where destinies are written, the Ninja must get the Sword of Sanctuary, a powerful relic that can see past the traps surrounding the tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master – but tensions are high as Moro’s escape from the Cursed  …
The Ninja now have all the items they need to get to the tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master but before they can figure out the last riddle that leads to the location of the tomb.
The Ninja use Ronan’s airship to travel to the tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master in an underwater cave under the ocean, only to find out Moro is already there.

When Moro uses the Realm Crystal to open a portal to the Cursed Realm, ghosts take over the town - but the Ninja, in disguise, manage to get Lloyd to the center of the town and Lloyd steals the crystal…
As the ghosts converge around and mobilize the Preeminent into a hulking giant behemoth, the Ninja use Airjitzu to fight the mobile beast in an attempt to slow it down.
After the defeat of the ghosts and the destruction of the Cursed Realm, the ninja finds themselves famous all over Ninjago.
With Destiny’s Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn.
